Data Scientist (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Data Scientists who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. Ifyou're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

Develop and Deploy Production-Grade AI Systems 

  • Build, deploy, and maintain scalable APIs that serve AI/ML models in production environments 

  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI solutions, from prototyping to fully productionized systems 

Design Advanced AI Architectures 

  • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using vector databases 

  • Build and orchestrate AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Evaluate and select appropriate large language models (LLMs) and foundation models based on specific use cases 

Optimize Performance and Scalability 

  • Continuously optimize model inference for latency, cost efficiency, and throughput at scale 

  • Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to ensure high-performing systems 

Ensure Reliability and Observability 

  • Implement robust monitoring, logging, and alerting for deployed models and services 

  • Ensure system reliability, uptime, and performance through best practices in production ML systems 

Establish Engineering Best Practices 

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for seamless testing, deployment, and iteration of AI systems 

  • Contribute to evolving engineering standards as the company transitions from rapid experimentation to more structured, scalable operations 

Collaborate Cross-Functionally 

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into core products 

  • Translate business problems into technical solutions and clearly communicate trade-offs 

Drive Structure in a Fast-Paced Environment 

  • Help bring stability and structure to AI development processes during a high-growth, scale-up phase 

  • Balance speed of execution with the need for maintainable, well-documented, and scalable systems 

  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them through to practical, production-ready outcomes 


Core Experience 

  • 5+ years of experience in Python, with ~10 years of overall software engineering or data experience (candidates transitioning from backend engineering are welcome) 

  • Proven experience building and deploying production-grade APIs (preferably with FastAPI; REST/GraphQL experience is a plus) 

  • Hands-on experience working with large language models (LLMs) and LLMOps, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation (e.g., GPT, Claude) 

  • Strong experience fine-tuning open-source models (e.g., Hugging Face ecosystem) 

  • Practical experience designing and working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector) 

  • Experience building AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Solid understanding of model deployment and serving (e.g., vLLM, TGI, or managed endpoints) 

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions) 

  • Strong experience working with and processing large-scale text datasets 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience with MLOps platforms such as MLflow or Weights & Biases 

  • Familiarity with cloud AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI) 

  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects 

  • Experience in the sustainability or climate/product domain 

  • Background in B2B SaaS environments 

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment (approximately 100–300 employees) 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

Key Attributes 

  • Builder mindset: Comfortable owning systems end-to-end, from experimentation through to production 

  • Bias for action: Operates effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities 

  • Systems thinker: Designs solutions with scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind 

  • Pragmatic decision-making: Balances technical excellence with speed and business impact 

  • Ownership & accountability: Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs 

  • Clear communicator: Able to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here

Die Basis ist da: Klaviyo, mehrere hunderttausend Leads und Kund:innen sowie jede Menge Daten. Was fehlt, ist eine klare CRM-Strategie mit intelligenter Segmentierung, automatisierten Lifecycle-Flows, strukturiertem Testing und einem Reporting, das Wirkung und Umsatzbeitrag sichtbar macht.

Du verschickst bei uns also nicht einfach Newsletter. Du gestaltest, wie wir entlang des gesamten Lifecycles Kund:innen ansprechen und langfristig binden. Dafür bekommst du echte Ownership, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Chance, CRM bei Kleines Kraftwerk von Grund auf zu prägen.

Bereit, aus CRM einen echten Wachstumstreiber zu machen?


Wofür du Verantwortung übernimmst



CRM lief bei uns bisher nebenbei – jetzt wollen wir daraus einen echten Wachstumstreiber machen. 

  • Du baust unsere CRM- und Lifecycle-Strategie auf: Du entwickelst Prozesse, Tools und Strukturen von Grund auf und richtest sie auf Kundenbindung und Wiederkäufe aus.
  • Du entwickelst unsere Lifecycle-Flows: In Klaviyo konzipierst und optimierst du automatisierte Customer Journeys von Welcome und Post-Purchase bis Cross-/Upselling und Win-back.
  • Du entwickelst relevante Kundensegmente: Leads und Kund:innen segmentierst du nach Kaufverhalten, Interessen und Lifecycle-Phase für eine gezielte Kundenansprache.
  • Du verantwortest unsere CRM-Kampagnen: Du steuerst Themen, Timing und Versand und stimmst dich eng mit Marketing und E-Commerce ab.
  • Du etablierst eine Test- und Lernkultur: Mit strukturierten A/B-Tests identifizierst du Optimierungspotenziale und entwickelst unsere CRM-Maßnahmen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Du steuerst die CRM-Performance: Relevante KPIs und Reportings nutzt du, um Erfolge messbar zu machen und konkrete Maßnahmen abzuleiten.
  • Du stellst Datenqualität und Compliance sicher: Du sorgst für sauberes Listenmanagement und DSGVO-konforme CRM-Prozesse.
  • Du identifizierst die größten CRM-Hebel: Potenziale priorisierst du nach Business Impact und entwickelst perspektivisch weitere Retention-Programme wie Loyalty und Referral.


Womit du punkten kannst

Du kennst CRM nicht nur aus der Theorie. Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im CRM-, Lifecycle- oder Retention-Marketing mit und weißt, wie aus Kundendaten relevante Kommunikation und messbare Kundenbindung entsteht. Dabei wartest du nicht auf Vorgaben, sondern erkennst Potenziale und setzt sie eigenständig um.

  • Du kennst CRM aus der Praxis: Du bringst ca. 4+ Jahre Erfahrung mit, idealerweise im E-Commerce- oder D2C-Umfeld, und hast eine CRM-Funktion bereits aufgebaut oder maßgeblich weiterentwickelt.

  • Du kommunizierst souverän: Du arbeitest eng mit unterschiedlichen Teams zusammen und kannst dich auf Deutsch sehr sicher und klar verständigen.

  • du ein fertiges CRM-Setup mit bestehenden Prozessen und Playbooks übernehmen möchtest – bei uns baust du vieles selbst auf.
  • du lange Freigabeprozesse einer schnellen, direkten Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung vorziehst.
  • du ausschließlich Kampagnen versenden möchtest, ohne Verantwortung für Segmentierung, Testing und Reporting zu übernehmen.
  • Datenarbeit für dich eher Pflicht als Werkzeug ist und du ausschließlich kreativ arbeiten möchtest.
  • fehlende Prozesse und Unklarheit dich eher stressen als motivieren – ein fertiges CRM-Handbuch gibt es bei uns noch nicht.


Worauf du dich freuen kannst

  • CRM aufbauen statt nur verwalten: Du bekommst volle Gestaltungsfreiheit beim Aufbau unserer CRM-Funktion und kannst Strukturen, Prozesse und Maßnahmen von Grund auf mitgestalten.

  • Gemeinsam möchten wir wachsen: Wir setzen auf ein starkes WIR-Gefühl, eine freundschaftliche Teamkultur, flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege.

  • Work-Life-Balance ist uns wichtig: du hast flexible Arbeitszeiten, 2 Tage Home-Office pro Woche, 28 Tage Urlaub sowie 5 Tage Workation im Jahr, außerdem hast du an deinem Geburtstag frei!
  • Deine Gesundheit und Zukunft liegen uns am Herzen: Du erhältst Zuschüsse zu Wellpass und betrieblicher Altersvorsorge sowie exklusive Rabatte auf unsere Produkte.
  • Ein Arbeitsplatz zum Wohlfühlen: Dich erwarten moderne, lichtdurchflutete Büros und eine phänomenale Dachterrasse, die zum Durchatmen und Austauschen einlädt.

Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Start-up im Bereich erneuerbare Energien mit einer klaren Mission: erneuerbare Energie von morgen für alle zugänglich machen. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, eigene Ideen einbringen und Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen: in einer dynamischen Umgebung, in der du viel Gestaltungsspielraum hast, Strukturen mit aufbauen kannst, eigene Entscheidungen triffst und direkten Einfluss auf den Erfolg des Unternehmens nimmst.

Deine Aufgaben im Detail: Du entwickelst Content-Konzepte für unsere Amazon-Präsenz. Dabei definierst du die inhaltliche Struktur unserer Produktdetailseiten und erarbeitest Konzepte für Produktabbildungen und A+ Content. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Inhalte verständlich, markengerecht und verkaufsstark aufgebaut sind. Du optimierst unsere Inhalte hinsichtlich SEO und GEO. Mithilfe fundierter Keyword-Recherchen und gängiger Tools wie Helium 10 und den Seller Central internen Tools verbesserst du die Performance unserer Listings. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du unsere Produktdetailseiten mit Blick auf Shopping-Assistenten wie Amazon Rufus und Alexa weiter. Du verbindest kreative Ideen mit messbarer Performance. Du analysierst relevante E-Commerce-KPIs, Verkaufszahlen, Kundenfeedback und die Performance unseres Amazon Brand Stores. Daraus leitest du Zielgruppenansätze, Hypothesen, Testprioritäten und konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab. Du entwickelst unseren Amazon Brand Store kontinuierlich weiter. Von der inhaltlichen Planung über die Pflege bis zur Optimierung gestaltest du eine Customer Journey, die unsere Marken erlebbar macht und Kund:innen gezielt zu den passenden Produkten führt. Du testest, lernst und optimierst. Du konzipierst A/B-Tests für Texte, Produktdetailseiten und visuelle Inhalte, begleitest deren Durchführung und Auswertung und überführst die Erkenntnisse in neue Content-Konzepte. Du sorgst für einen kontinuierlichen Austausch über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg. Gemeinsam mit E-Commerce, E-Commerce-Grafik, Produktmanagement und weiteren Schnittstellen koordinierst du Inhalte und stellst eine konsistente, markengerechte und performante Produktpräsentation sicher. Ihr Profil Du bringst mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung im E-Commerce-Content-Management mit und verbindest kreative Content-Entwicklung mit analytischem Denken. Du weißt, wie Produktdetailseiten, A+ Content, Brand Story, Landingpages und Amazon Brand Store aufgebaut sein müssen, um Zielgruppen zu überzeugen und messbar zur Performance beizutragen. Gleichzeitig hast du Freude daran, Inhalte auf Basis von KPIs, Kundenfeedback und Testergebnissen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und gemeinsam mit E-Commerce, E-Commerce-Grafik und weiteren Fachabteilungen unsere Amazon-Präsenz zu optimieren. Das bringst du im Detail mit: Erste Erfahrung: Du verfügst über 3-5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im E-Commerce, Online-Marketing, Marketplace-Management und in der Produktdatenpflege. Erfahrung im Umgang mit Amazon Seller Central ist Voraussetzung. Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung digitaler Content-Konzepte und weißt, wie überzeugende Produkttexte, Landingpages, A+ Content und Amazon Brand Store aufgebaut sein müssen. Du verbindest Kreativität mit analytischem Denken und gehst sicher mit relevanten E-Commerce-KPIs um, um die Wirkung von Content zu bewerten und Optimierungspotenziale zu erkennen. Du kennst dich mit Amazon SEO, Keyword-Recherchen und der Optimierung von Produktdetailseiten aus. Erfahrung mit gängigen Tools wie Helium 10 ist dabei ein großes Plus. Du beschäftigst dich mit den Möglichkeiten von GEO und hast Interesse daran, Produktinhalte auch für KI-gestützte Such- und Shopping-Assistenten wie Amazon Rufus und Alexa weiterzuentwickeln. Du hast Erfahrung mit A/B-Tests und Customer-Journey-Analysen und kannst aus Daten, Kundenfeedback und Testergebnissen konkrete Maßnahmen für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Inhalte ableiten. Du nutzt KI-Tools gezielt für Recherche, Konzeption, Texterstellung und Optimierung. Dabei verbindest du technologische Möglichkeiten mit deinem eigenen Gespür für Sprache, Marke und Zielgruppe. Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenständig und abteilungsübergreifend. Eine offene Kommunikation, ein kontinuierlicher Austausch mit relevanten Schnittstellen und ein gutes Gespür für Prioritäten zeichnen dich aus. Warum wir? Eine verantwortungsvolle Position in einem dynamischen und wachsenden Unternehmen. Die Möglichkeit, die E-Commerce-Strategie aktiv mitzugestalten und den Erfolg des Unternehmens langfristig zu sichern. Ein motiviertes Team und enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Grafik-Abteilung, um eine einheitliche Markenpräsentation über verschiedene Kanäle hinweg sicherzustellen. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, teilweise im Home-Office zu arbeiten. Ein unbefristeter Vertrag, der dir Sicherheit gibt. Fahrtkostenübernahme, wenn du die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel nutzt. Monatlich einen steuerfreien Benefit in Form einer Sachbezugskarte nach der Probezeit. Deine Aufgaben

  • Trend-Spotting: Übersetze aktuelle Social Trends und Insights in überzeugende Social-First-Narrative, auch für Influencer- und Creator-Konzepte

  • Content-Struktur: Unterstütze bei der Entwicklung und Strukturierung unserer Content-Formate (Always-on & Kampagnen, z. B. Hero/Hub/Help)
  • Hands-on-Produktion: Arbeite mit interdisziplinären Teams, begleite Produktionen und nutze Prototyping (Moodboards, Storyboards) für den finalen Vibe-Check und die Qualitätssicherung
  • AI & Data-Driven: Nutze AI-Tools für deine Ideation-Sessions und die Umsetzung. Du denkst datenbasiert und hast ein Grundverständnis für Creative KPIs und Testing


Dein Profil

  • Du bringst mindestens 6 Jahre Creative-Erfahrung mit einem klaren Fokus auf Konzept & Copy sowie ein starkes Gespür für Social-First-Content mit
  • Du verstehst die Dynamik von Plattformen und Trends (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, Snap – you name it) und bist sicher in der Kommunikation und im Copywriting auf Deutsch (C2-Level) & Englisch (C1-Level)
  • Du hast eine Hands-on-Mentalität, liebst das Testing und bist versiert im Umgang mit Creative KPIs und Performance-Denken
  • Du nutzt AI-Tools für Ideation und Content und bist sicher im Einsatz von Figma und/oder der Adobe Creative Cloud
  • Du bringst Erfahrung mit Influencer-/Creator-Kampagnen und Consumer Brands mit


Warum wir?

  • Attraktives Gehalt & flexibles Arbeiten – Bei uns arbeitest du hybrid, mit Workation-Möglichkeit und flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, damit du Job und Leben optimal verbinden kannst

title: InnoMaster Big Data Engineering - part-time Master's Program
description: Part-time Master's Program starting April 2027   Do you have a passion for Big Data? Do you want to make your Master studies exciting and practical? Do you wish to continue studying after your Bachelor's degree while simultaneously stepping into the professional world? And all this with a fixed monthly salary and complete coverage of tuition fees? Then, our  InnoMaster Program  is just right for you!   As part of the  InnoMaster Big Data Engineering Program , you'll typically study alongside your job at a university offering an accredited part-time Master's program in IT/Data Engineering located in Hamburg or its surroundings (e.g. FH Wedel) , and we'll cover the costs for you! Concurrently, you'll gain valuable practical work experience working within various Big Data environments such as Google Cloud and on-site Hadoop, allowing you to apply your theoretical knowledge directly into practice! Support our Data Engineers and Data Scientists in processing, managing, and analyzing our data. In addition to responsible tasks and appropriate compensation, we offer participation in training sessions (related to the field, programming languages, or soft skills) and support in further career development.   The  InnoMaster Big Data Engineering program  is designed for approximately three years, with a weekly workload of 25-40 hours depending on your university schedule. We are happy to assist if you have further questions regarding the program.   Your skill set Bachelor degree.  You have completed your IT-related bachelor's or diploma studies with good grades (GPA of 2.5 or better). Admission requirements.  You meet the admission requirements of your preferred IT or data-related program at a university in the Hamburg area. Data engineering.  Your personal software projects reflect your affinity for software development and data engineering. Big Data.  You have an interest in Big Data ecosystems, some experience with Java and Python is a plus. Soft skills.  You enjoy working independently with a strong team-oriented mentality; demonstrate a high level of self-initiative and quick comprehension. English as our company language.  You look forward to using your excellent English skills in both spoken and written form daily. Your power-ups Team of specialists.  Be part of a stable, growing, and award-winning global company. Meet your future colleagues in  Development & IT  in this video. Perfect learning environment.  We offer you an extremely interesting technical environment and state-of-the-art working conditions. Career development.  We support your professional and personal development with optimal guidance from a contact person in the department and from People & Culture. Monthly salary plus education costs.  We finance your full tuition fees, including books, plus a monthly salary of € 2.531 ,- gross per month. Outstanding equipment.  You work with a fully equipped MacBook Pro, and we provide you with a smartphone or tablet of your choice. Agile work.  You can expect flexible working hours and agile, cross-functional teams with short decision-making paths. Team events.  Participate in regular team events (e.g., wine tasting, cooking, paintball), barbecue together on our rooftop terrace, and enjoy regular company-get-togethers. Comfy and modern office.  We offer you various possibilities to combine work and well-being: fresh fruit and complimentary drinks, in-house fitness studio, gaming area, rooftop terrace with BBQ, relaxing rooms, and much more. InnoGames is one of the leading German developers and publishers of mobile and browser games and a certified Great Place to Work®. The Hamburg-based company was founded in 2007 and is now part of Modern Times Group (MTG). Together with about 350 employees from 40 nations, the company founders develop unique games that provide many years of fun for millions of players around the world.   • Begin developing familiarity with our business, platform, and applications, as well as our company’s key metrics

  • Acclimate yourself with the day-to-day responsibilities of Zip’s Business Development team by shadowing team members, listening to recorded customer calls, and working closely with our Account Executive team

Within 1 month, you will...

  • Identify and contact prospective clients to build a pipeline through a variety of methods including, but not limited to cold-calling, emailing, social media outreach, and mass email campaigns

  • Create a professional and engaging first impression with our prospects and customers

  • Create, maintain and update our database of prospects with complete information and emails

  • Become a mentor to new hires entering into the Business Development organization

title: CPO - Chief Product Officer (m/w/d)
description: Stellenbeschreibung Pammys ist in wenigen Jahren auf über 1,3 Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen. Jetzt bauen wir die Product Organisation für unsere nächste Wachstumsphase: neue Kategorien, höhere Volumen, internationale Märkte und ein global skalierbares Produktionsnetzwerk. Dafür suchen wir einen Chief Product Officer (m/w/d), der unsere gesamte Product Organisation aufbaut, führt und auf das nächste Level bringt. Wir suchen keinen CPO, der Produkt nur aus Strategie-Meetings kennt. Wir suchen einen Builder und Operator, der weiß, wie man Product Development, Engineering, Design, Merchandising, Sourcing, Production, Quality und Product Marketing zu einer leistungsfähigen Organisation verbindet. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Gründern unsere langfristige Produkt- und Kategoriestrategie und verantwortest gleichzeitig, dass diese operativ funktioniert. Wenn ein Development-Prozess nicht funktioniert, gehst du rein. Wenn Qualität, Costing oder Timelines nicht stimmen, willst du verstehen warum und löst das Problem gemeinsam mit deinem Team. Wenn entscheidende Kompetenzen fehlen, baust du sie auf. Ein zentraler Bestandteil deiner Rolle ist der Aufbau unserer internationalen Product- und Sourcing-Struktur in China und perspektivisch weiteren Produktionsmärkten wie Vietnam. Dein Ziel ist klar: Bessere Produkte. Schnellere Entwicklungszyklen. Höhere Qualität. Stärkere Margen. Klare Ownership. Eine Product Organisation, die mit Pammys skalieren kann. Deine Aufgaben Du verantwortest den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung zentraler Unternehmensbereiche und entwickelst Strukturen, Verantwortlichkeiten, Prozesse und Führung konsequent weiter. Du baust leistungsfähige Teams und Funktionen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette auf – von Strategie und Entwicklung über Beschaffung und Produktion bis hin zu Vermarktung und kommerzieller Steuerung. Du rekrutierst, führst und entwickelst starke Führungskräfte und Spezialisten und schaffst eine Organisation, die eigenständig, klar strukturiert und skalierbar arbeitet. Gemeinsam mit den Gründern entwickelst du die langfristige Unternehmens- und Wachstumsstrategie und übersetzt sie in klare Prioritäten, Strukturen und operative Maßnahmen. Du stellst sicher, dass strategische Initiativen von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung effizient, bereichsübergreifend und ergebnisorientiert gesteuert werden. Du optimierst Prozesse mit dem Ziel, Entscheidungswege zu verkürzen, Komplexität zu reduzieren und die Organisation schneller und leistungsfähiger zu machen. Du entwickelst unser internationales Partner-, Produktions- und Lieferantennetzwerk weiter und führst strategische Verhandlungen zu Kosten, Kapazitäten, Qualität, Zeitplänen und Rahmenbedingungen. Du baust gemeinsam mit uns unsere internationale Präsenz, insbesondere in China, weiter aus und entwickelst dort langfristig ein leistungsfähiges lokales Team. Du etablierst klare Qualitäts-, Steuerungs- und Kontrollmechanismen und stellst sicher, dass vereinbarte Standards im Tagesgeschäft konsequent umgesetzt werden. Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit den relevanten Teams die kommerzielle Steuerung zentraler Geschäftsbereiche – einschließlich Kosten, Preisen, Margen, Mengen, Zeitplänen und Profitabilität. Du schaffst klare Verantwortlichkeiten und stellst sicher, dass wichtige Initiativen über alle beteiligten Funktionen hinweg konsequent vorangetrieben werden. Du verknüpfst Strategie und operative Umsetzung eng mit Kundenbedürfnissen, Marktkenntnissen und kommerziellem Potenzial. Du arbeitest regelmäßig direkt mit unseren internationalen Teams und Partnern zusammen und steigst bei kritischen Themen auch selbst tief in operative Fragestellungen ein. Dein Profil Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung auf Director-, VP-, SVP- oder C-Level im Product-Bereich einer Footwear Brand oder eines vergleichbaren internationalen Consumer-Unternehmens. Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Skalierung einer multidisziplinären Product Organisation. Tiefgehendes Know-how in Footwear Development, Engineering, Construction, Materials, Fit, Sampling, Testing und Production. Langjährige direkte Erfahrung mit Footwear-Fabriken und Produktionspartnern in China sowie idealerweise ein belastbares Netzwerk im asiatischen Beschaffungsmarkt. Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Sourcing, Costing, Supplier Management, Production Planning und kommerziellen Verhandlungen. Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Skalierung von Produktportfolios, Kategorien und internationalen Produktlinien. Starkes kommerzielles Verständnis für Marge, Pricing, Herstellkosten, Volumen, Sortiment und Produktprofitabilität. Du kannst Strategie auf C-Level entwickeln und gleichzeitig operativ tief genug einsteigen, um komplexe Product-, Development- oder Production-Probleme selbst zu verstehen und voranzutreiben. Du bist ein Builder und fühlst dich in einer Organisation wohl, in der Strukturen nicht vollständig vorgegeben sind, sondern von dir geschaffen werden. Du führst mit hohen Standards, klarer Verantwortung und starker Execution. Du triffst Entscheidungen schnell, datenbasiert und mit ausgeprägtem unternehmerischem Verständnis. title: (Senior) Marketing Controller (m/w/d)
description: Stellenbeschreibung Du reportest nicht, was passiert ist. Du sorgst dafür, dass wir wissen, was als Nächstes passieren muss. Pammys ist in nur vier Jahren auf über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen und gehört zu den am schnellsten wachsenden E-Commerce-Unternehmen Europas. Heute arbeiten über 150 Mitarbeitende an unseren Standorten in Hamburg, Kiel und unserem eigenen 22.0 00 m² Logistikzentrum in Lensahn daran, aus Pammys eine globale Footwear Brand zu machen. Mit einem Umsatz im mittleren 8-stelligen Bereich, mehreren Millionen Euro Marketinginvestitionen pro Monat, internationalem Wachstum und einem Produktvolumen in Millionenhöhe wird eine Sache immer wichtiger: Finanzielle Steuerung auf höchstem Niveau. Deshalb bauen wir unser Controlling massiv aus und suchen vier (Senior) Controller / Finance Business Partner (m/w/d) , die gemeinsam mit uns die nächste Wachstumsphase steuern. Bei uns geht es nicht darum, Excel-Dateien zu verwalten oder rückblickend Zahlen zusammenzufassen. Du sitzt nah an den Entscheidungen, challengest Annahmen, erkennst Abweichungen frühzeitig und übersetzt Zahlen in konkrete Maßnahmen. Dein Ziel: Wachstum profitabel machen und jederzeit wissen, welche Stellschraube den größten finanziellen Impact hat. Je nach Erfahrung und Schwerpunkt übernimmst du Verantwortung für einen oder mehrere unserer zentralen Unternehmensbereiche wie Marketing & E-Commerce, Product & Sourcing, Operations & Logistics oder Corporate Finance . Deine Aufgaben Du übernimmst im Marketing die Analyse und Weiterentwicklung unserer Kennzahlen und schaffst damit eine fundierte Grundlage für datenbasierte Entscheidungen. Du analysierst relevante Marketing-KPIs und stellst sicher, dass Abweichungen frühzeitig erkannt und konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen abgeleitet werden. Du bewertest die Performance unserer Marketingkanäle und Kampagnen bis auf Zielgruppen-, Produkt- oder Marktebene und identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale. Du analysierst Conversion Rates, Kundenakquisitionskosten, Return on Ad Spend und Customer Lifetime Value und machst Zusammenhänge transparent. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Marketing, Finance und Data aussagekräftige Reportings, Dashboards und Frühwarnsysteme . Du verbindest Marketing-Kennzahlen mit wirtschaftlichen Ergebnissen und zeigst auf, welche Maßnahmen zur Kundengewinnung, Kundenbindung und Profitabilität beitragen . Du erstellst Performance-Prognosen und Szenarioanalysen und bewertest die möglichen Auswirkungen unterschiedlicher Marketingmaßnahmen. Du definierst gemeinsam mit den Verantwortlichen klare Zielwerte, Benchmarks und Performance-KPIs und machst die Zielerreichung messbar. Du analysierst die Customer Journey und den Conversion Funnel und identifizierst Potenziale zur Verbesserung von Conversion, Wiederkaufrate und Kundenwert. Du wertest A/B-Tests und Kampagnenexperimente aus und leitest fundierte Empfehlungen für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Marketingaktivitäten ab. Du stellst die Qualität, Konsistenz und Nachvollziehbarkeit unserer Marketingdaten sicher und entwickelst Kennzahlendefinitionen sowie Messmethoden weiter. Du treibst die Automatisierung und Standardisierung des Marketing-Reportings voran. Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Geschäftsführung, Finance, Data und Sales zusammen und bereitest Erkenntnisse verständlich und entscheidungsorientiert auf. Dein Profil Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Finance, Controlling, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Besonders spannend ist Erfahrung aus E-Commerce, D2C, Retail, Fashion, FMCG oder einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen . Du verstehst Marketing nicht nur technisch, sondern kannst erklären, welche operative Entscheidung hinter einer Veränderung steckt . Du bist extrem sicher in Excel oder Google Sheets und kannst auch große Datenmengen strukturiert analysieren. Erfahrung mit BI-Tools, ERP-Systemen und automatisierten Reportings ist ein großes Plus. Du arbeitest analytisch und präzise, verlierst dich aber nicht in Analysen, sondern kommst schnell zu einer klaren Empfehlung. Du hast den Anspruch, Zahlen zu challengen , statt sie lediglich entgegenzunehmen. Du kannst komplexe Sachverhalte so erklären, dass auch Nicht-Marketer verstehen, was zu tun ist. Du arbeitest eigenständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem Entscheidungen schnell getroffen und Ergebnisse klar gemessen werden. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Deine Vorteile bei Pammys Echter Einfluss: Deine Analysen landen nicht in einer Präsentation, sondern direkt in operativen und strategischen Entscheidungen. Unternehmerisches Controlling: Du bekommst eigene Verantwortungsbereiche und wirst zum Sparringspartner für die jeweiligen Führungskräfte. Außergewöhnliche Skalierung: Du begleitest ein Unternehmen auf dem Weg vom mittleren 8-stelligen in den mittleren 9-stelligen Umsatzbereich. Komplexität, an der du wachsen kannst: E-Commerce, Marketing, internationale Märkte, eigene Logistik, Sourcing und Millionen von Produkten ergeben ein Finance-Umfeld, das weit über klassisches Controlling hinausgeht. Gestaltung statt Verwaltung: Viele Strukturen entstehen gerade erst. Du kannst Prozesse, Dashboards, KPIs und Steuerungsmodelle aktiv mit aufbauen. Kurze Entscheidungswege: Keine endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen. Gute Analysen werden schnell in Entscheidungen übersetzt. High-Performance-Umfeld: Klare Ziele, messbare Ergebnisse, hohe Eigenverantwortung und der Anspruch, jeden Bereich kontinuierlich besser zu machen. Entwicklungsperspektive: Mit dem weiteren Wachstum entstehen zusätzliche Verantwortungsbereiche und Führungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb unseres Finance-Teams. Zusätzliche Benefits: Mitarbeiterrabatte, Corporate Benefits, kostenlose Getränke und weitere Vorteile. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

The Task: We are not hiring you to maintain a warm book of business. We are bringing you on to architect our zero-to-one acquisition strategy targeting the backbone of the German economy: German SMBs and high-growth companies (500 to 2,000 FTEs). Output: Executed Master Service Agreements (MSAs) secured with C-level, Tech, and HR/Procurement stakeholders. Metrics of Performance: Deal velocity (maintaining a fast, consistent sales cycle) and accurate, predictable Salesforce forecasting. Pillar 3: Revenue Activation & Orchestration Action: Seamlessly orchestrate the post-signature handover to the Account Management team, ensuring clients are strategically primed and incentivized to deploy freelancers immediately. Output: Rapid deployment of freelance talent within newly signed accounts. Metrics of Performance: Total Annual Contract Value (ACV) signed and the maximization of actual revenue generated within the first 12 months post-MSA. Requirements & The Skills Matrix 🔍 Proven Mastery: 2-3 years of AE and/or SDR experience, demonstrating autonomy and execution capability. A documented track record of conquering "Big Local Players" in the German market, rather than coasting on brand recognition from large multinational HQs. Demonstrated success selling within the Professional Services or SaaS industries (ideally both). Deep, practical fluency in SPIN and MEDDIC methodologies. Skills You Will Deploy & Develop: Mastering complex, multi-stakeholder procurement navigation (aligning HR, Tech, and Sourcing/Buying centers). Architecting digital transformation acceleration for traditional high-growth Mittelstand businesses. Advanced pipeline integrity and CRM (Salesforce) command, merging execution rigor with strategic business acumen.   • A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently
Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here!
At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive.

The Mission (Situation & Task) 🪐
  • The Situation: Malt is transforming how work gets done as Europe’s leading freelance marketplace. While we have historically excelled at developing deep client relationships, we have identified a strategic, high-priority gap in our Go-To-Market engine: aggressive, net-new client acquisition.
  • The Task: We are not hiring you to maintain a warm book of business. We are bringing you on to architect our zero-to-one acquisition strategy targeting the backbone of the German economy: German SMBs and high-growth companies (500 to 2,000 FTEs). You - as a team of 3 - will operate as the autonomous founder of your territory, designing your own outreach methodology and conquering major local players to drive our next phase of hyper-growth.

    • Key Responsibilities (Action & Output) ✨

    Pillar 1: Proactive Territory Architecture & Hunting

  • Action: Build and execute an intelligent outbound strategy targeting 15-20 key accounts per quarter, leveraging cold outreach, marketing intelligence, and strategic network mapping (including tracking alumni who used Malt at previous employers).
  • Output: A localized, highly qualified pipeline of net-new Mid-Market logos.
  • Metrics of Performance: Volume of Key Stakeholder Meetings booked per month, and the strict qualification/disqualification of ~15-20 accounts per quarter.

    • Pillar 2: Consultative Deal Leadership

  • Action: Command the entire sales cycle from initial discovery to final negotiation using rigorous MEDDIC and SPIN frameworks to diagnose complex business challenges.
  • Output: Executed Master Service Agreements (MSAs) secured with C-level, Tech, and HR/Procurement stakeholders.
  • Metrics of Performance: Deal velocity (maintaining a fast, consistent sales cycle) and accurate, predictable Salesforce forecasting.
    • Pillar 3: Revenue Activation & Orchestration
  • Action: Seamlessly orchestrate the post-signature handover to the Account Management team, ensuring clients are strategically primed and incentivized to deploy freelancers immediately.
  • Output: Rapid deployment of freelance talent within newly signed accounts.
  • Metrics of Performance: Total Annual Contract Value (ACV) signed and the maximization of actual revenue generated within the first 12 months post-MSA.

    • Requirements & The Skills Matrix 🔍

    Proven Mastery:

  • 2-3 years of AE and/or SDR experience, demonstrating autonomy and execution capability.
  • A documented track record of conquering "Big Local Players" in the German market, rather than coasting on brand recognition from large multinational HQs.
  • Demonstrated success selling within the Professional Services or SaaS industries (ideally both).
  • Deep, practical fluency in SPIN and MEDDIC methodologies.

    • Skills You Will Deploy & Develop:

  • Mastering complex, multi-stakeholder procurement navigation (aligning HR, Tech, and Sourcing/Buying centers).
  • Architecting digital transformation acceleration for traditional high-growth Mittelstand businesses.
  • Advanced pipeline integrity and CRM (Salesforce) command, merging execution rigor with strategic business acumen.

title: Senior Product Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Meet Yubico</strong></h3> <p>Yubico is a global leader in identity security and creator of the YubiKey, the original hardware-backed passkey. We are publicly traded on Nasdaq Stockholm; our global footprint includes headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, Silicon Valley, California; and Singapore.</p> <p><strong>Why Join Our Mission?</strong></p> <p>At Yubico, we are guided by a shared belief that your work matters. We operate under a cultural philosophy of <em>Speed with Integrity</em>, pushing the boundaries of technology to secure the AI frontier—protecting both human and agentic AI interactions—and leading the transition to post-quantum cryptography. In everything we do, we live by our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Battle Friction:</strong> We constantly look for new ways to simplify our products, our work, and the user experience.</li> <li><strong>Inspire Higher:</strong> We think big, champion the open internet, and strive to do the right thing even when it is difficult.</li> <li><strong>One Team:</strong> We are open, responsive, and collaborative, overcoming challenges and celebrating our successes together.</li> </ul> <p>Aligned with our commitment to open standards, we foster a thriving builder ecosystem through the<a href="https://developers.yubico.com/"> Yubico Developer Program</a>, offering free<a href="https://developers.yubico.com/Software_Projects/"> open-source repositories</a>, libraries, and SDKs to help developers rapidly integrate strong hardware authentication into any application. Through close collaborations with technical partners like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, as well as newer frontiers like OpenAI, we continue to shape a safer digital world while donating security keys to protect vulnerable communities, journalists, and humanitarian groups worldwide through our <a href="https://www.yubico.com/why-yubico/secure-it-forward/"><em>Secure it Forward</em></a> program.</p></div><p><strong>At Yubico, we offer:</strong></p> <p><strong>Yubico Values: </strong>We work to ensure that our employees have an open space to have their voices amplified to create a workplace where everyone feels like they belong. In support of this, our employees have created some pretty cool Employee Resource Groups that foster inclusion, help build community and connection across Yubico. Additionally, Yubico donates YubiKeys to organizations in need all over the world (you can read more about our work <a href="https://www.yubico.com/why-yubico/secure-it-forward/">here</a>).</p> <p><strong>Social Connection:</strong> Relationships and connectedness matter, and we love spending time with our team! Our virtual workspace keeps us connected day-to-day whether it's through Yubico celebrating wins or our buzzing Slack communities. Check out our<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/yubico/life/17456342-be9b-4b35-b561-9ea3e892e9cc/"> Life at Yubico Page</a> on LinkedIn and our awards<a href="https://www.yubico.com/about/awards/"> here</a><strong>.</strong></p> <h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2> <p>Yubico is looking for an experienced and highly collaborative Senior Product Manager to define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Tools, Libraries, and Applications (TLA) that underlie many of Yubico products and services. In this role, you will be a technical leader in our product management team and work closely with builders across a variety of our products&nbsp; from open source libraries and SDKs which empower other developers to create amazing things with our products, command line tools for managing and using YubiKeys and YubiHSMs, as well as graphical apps for mobile and desktop platforms.</p> <p>Our team works with authentication protocols like FIDO2/WebAuthn and uses cryptography to implement open standards. You'll have the opportunity to help us showcase our libraries in sample apps, making complex topics easier to use. You will help define and deliver the success of Yubico’s foundational product areas and expand the use of our technology to new and innovative areas that capture the market demand. You will serve as the strategic counterpart to our Senior Director of Engineering for Tools, Libraries &amp; Apps.</p> <p>This role will own the "what" and "why" behind the enterprise-grade, secured, and reliable software used to build new applications and services that expand the value of Yubico hardware and services. To succeed, you will work closely with other product managers, engineers, solutions engineers, and operations teams to translate complex business and technical requirements into a robust definition for the foundational tools, libraries and applications in our expanding product portfolio</p> <h2><strong>Tasks &amp; Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Product Strategy &amp; Roadmap Ownership:</strong> Define and execute the long-term product vision and roadmap for our foundational tools, libraries, and applications, ensuring tight alignment with overarching business goals and customer needs.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Partner deeply across Engineering, Product, Operations, and Security teams to design high-impact capabilities that enhance product foundations that underlie efficiency and scalability of our solutions.</li> <li><strong>Customer focus</strong>: Meet with customers to understand market demand and outcomes for new products</li> <li><strong>Requirements Definition:</strong> Translate complex workflows and software requirements into clear, high-quality product requirement documents (PRDs) and user stories.</li> <li><strong>Technical Partnership &amp; Conflict Resolution:</strong> Serve as the strategic unifier in cross-functional technical decisions. Actively synthesize competing priorities between product vision and architectural necessity, ensuring trade-offs are documented, data-backed, and optimized for long-term reliability.</li> <li><strong>Data-driven Insights</strong>: Provide data-driven insights on the specific products being managed, including sales and financial performance, year-over-year trends, pipeline, etc.</li> <li><strong>Full life cycle management: </strong>Manage the full life-cycle of a product from inception to end of life including: conception, market and requirements gathering, customer validation, creation of high-quality requirements document, management of engineering, marketing preparation, release and end-of-life processes</li> <li><strong>Security &amp; Compliance Management:</strong> Collaborate with security and engineering teams to ensure software systems seamlessly integrate with critical cryptographic infrastructure (such as PKI and HSMs) while maintaining Yubico's gold standard of security.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Basic Qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).</li> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 10+ years of progressively broadening product management experience, with a strong track record of shipping complex, enterprise-class hardware &amp; manufacturing solutions.</li> <li><strong>Domain Expertise:</strong> Proven experience in technical product management including development of large-scale internal tools.</li> <li><strong>Leadership &amp; Acumen:</strong> Proven ability to act as a constructive challenger to highly technical engineering partners. Strong business and technical acumen with the confidence to debate architectural tradeoffs and act as a constructive challenger in deeply technical environments and manage competing priorities across geographically distributed teams.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills to align multi-disciplinary teams toward a unified vision.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Cryptographic Systems: </strong>Understanding of cryptographic systems, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), or Key Management Systems utilizing Hardware Security Modules (HSMs).</li> <li><strong>Analytical Mindset:</strong> Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a hands-on approach to diving deep into technical workflows alongside engineering teams.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>U.S. benefits designed for your overall well-being:</strong></span></p> <p><strong>Health coverage.</strong> We’ve got you covered with top of the line health plans, including dental and vision. We pay 100% of your premium and 85% for your family.</p> <p><strong>Retirement plan.</strong> Our retirement plan includes a 401K dollar per dollar match up to 6% with a cap of $6K/year. Immediate vesting.</p> <p><strong>Wellness reimbursement.</strong> We offer $1,200.00 in wellness earnings (prorated based on start date) that you can use on your gym membership, a massage, or your favorite online fitness classes. This is a taxable benefit if you choose to participate.</p> <p><strong>Learning and development.</strong> We encourage your professional growth and offer a yearly development stipend of $3,000 and mentorship program.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Time off.</strong> We offer a total of 15 vacation days plus 10 holidays, and 7 sick days a year.</p> <p><strong>Paid parental leave.</strong> We love welcoming new family members to our YubiTeam! All parents receive 8 weeks of paid leave. Birthing parents receive an additional 8 weeks of paid leave (16 weeks total).&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Commuter Benefits.</strong> If you need to commute to the office, we offer commuter benefits.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Strong mission &amp; company values.</strong> We’re a global team on a global mission to make the internet more secure for everyone. We believe that every person’s work matters. That you should always be nice, stay humble, and have fun, and never take yourself too seriously.</p> <p>#LI-BR1<br>#LI-Remote</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;">Yubico offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work. This role has the annual salary range as defined below for a salary pay range for a candidate located in the San Francisco Bay Area. For roles that are filled in other locations, the compensation range will be based on data provided by the Radford McLagan Compensation Database from Aon. Final compensation is also based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.</span></p></div><div class="title">Salary Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$175,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$210,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>We are an equal opportunity employer, we value diversity and uphold an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. We'd love to learn about what you can add to our diverse team. We are an E-Verify Participating Employer.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Yubico does not accept agency resumes or referrals so please do not send them to our careers staff or employees. Yubico is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes or referrals.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Personal data submitted through this form is used for managing Yubico’s recruitment activities, which include facilitating any application you make, setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing results and selecting candidates, and as otherwise needed in our recruitment and onboarding processes. The use of your personal data may also be necessary prior to entering into a contract with you (that is prior to offering you a job with Yubico). Your personal data will only be used for the purposes for which it was collected and in accordance with the <a href="https://www.yubico.com/support/terms-conditions/privacy-notice/">Yubico Privacy Notice</a>. We only keep your personal data for as long as necessary and in compliance with Yubico’s record retention policies. If you have asked us to, we will keep you informed of other opportunities at Yubico. We do this in various ways, including email and by phone. If at any time you do not want us to contact you or use your information as described herein please contact us at ----- to let us know and we will delete all such information. Providing your personal data is voluntary, but necessary to join our talent community, and if you do not agree to provide your data, we will not be able to consider you as part of our talent community.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>As part of providing the requested service, we will transfer your data to be processed by <a href="https://www.greenhouse.com/privacy-policy-june-27-2024" target="_blank">Greenhouse Software Inc.</a>,&nbsp;a service provider contracted by Yubico AB and/or its subsidiaries that meets legally mandated privacy requirements. The Yubico Privacy Notice offers more information about Yubico privacy practices, including the lawful basis for processing of personal data, how to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority, and how to contact Yubico to exercise your data subject rights. In this notice, when we refer to "Yubico", "us", "we" or "our", we mean the Yubico group company or companies that you apply to, or correspond with, and which are responsible for any personal data collected about you.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.description:

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionising the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective — providing operators with a decisive edge in contested environments.

We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe, today.


About the team

Our software program comprises several teams around R&D on both Command&Control (C2) and Autonomy functions as well as Delivery and Operations capabilities. Every unmanned system in the STARK portfolio relies on this single, rapidly evolving, reliable, and intelligent software program. Our teams are distributed across several locations in Europe and Ukraine.


To drive the development of our core command and control suite, we are looking for a Director Minerva Frontline Applications.


Your mission

Commanding the Frontline

As the Director Minerva Frontline Applications, you are at the helm of STARK's C2 software team. You will build and scale the central control suite for all unmanned systems in our portfolio, ensuring it remains interoperable, battle-tested, and exceptionally intuitive for operators. 
Your mandate is to:

  • Lead and inspire a multidisciplinary engineering organization comprising four core teams: Frontend Engineering, Backend Engineering, Integration Engineering, and Agentic C2.

  • Double-lead alongside the Chief Architect. You will own the people management and the "what" (roadmap, features, and team direction), while the Architect owns the "how" (engineering execution and technical quality).

  • Drive rapid innovation by overseeing a dedicated squad focused on pushing the edge of the possible in C2, quickly prototyping new concepts to drive new capabilities into operation through real-world impact.

  • Unify physical and digital by ensuring Minerva Frontline seamlessly connects to all STARK physical programs, capable of commanding specific hardware features under real-world conditions.


You are an energetic and highly structured leader who thrives at the intersection of rapid innovation and battle-tested reliability, possessing the drive to orchestrate a multidisciplinary software organization in a high-stakes environment where "good enough" is never the standard. The role is for someone who: 

  • Brings infectious energy and structure, exciting the team to tackle the complex tasks ahead.

  • Collaborates deeply to integrate a growing number of system and battlefield requirements into Minerva Frontline Applications.

  • Communicates crisply and persuasively across all levels.

  • Keeps teams aligned and executing flawlessly when stakes are at their highest.

  • Turns ambiguity into a clear, actionable direction.


Responsibilities

Own the "What" & People Management

  • You are the operational and visionary leader of the team, defining what gets built and ensuring the people building it are supported and thriving.

  • People Leadership: Act as the primary people manager for the entire Minerva Frontline Applications team, fostering an energetic, high-performance culture.

  • Roadmap Ownership: Drive the team's dedicated development roadmap to create a battle-tested software suite that works to the highest standards under real-life conditions.

  • Requirements Structuring: Partner closely with other program leads to structure tasks, define clear objectives, and prioritize features for the engineering squads.


The Double-Lead Partnership

  • You operate in lockstep with the Team Architect to ensure visionary goals meet flawless technical execution.

  • Collaborative Decision-Making: Make critical roadmap and product decisions in close collaboration with the Architect, ensuring all plans are technically viable and can be seamlessly executed.

  • Quality Assurance: Align your product vision with the Architect's engineering strategy to guarantee an extraordinary level of quality in our software output.


Orchestrate Cross-Functional Delivery & Innovation

  • You coordinate diverse engineering disciplines to deliver a unified, mass-scalable C2 product.

  • Team Synchronization: Synchronize the efforts of your engineering teams to deliver cohesive, reliable software updates.

  • Edge-of-the-Possible R&D: Guide the innovation team to quickly try out new things, evaluating prototypes to make decisive calls on which capabilities graduate into the actual software suite.

  • Hardware Interoperability: Maintain tight ties to all STARK physical programs, ensuring the software suite controls all specific features of our unmanned systems while remaining operator-friendly.


Qualifications

Experience

  • Proven experience in software engineering leadership, specifically managing multi-disciplinary teams.

  • Demonstrated success in double-leadership or highly collaborative models, particularly partnering with technical architects or lead engineers.

  • Experience building mission-critical software suites—ideally with ties to hardware, robotics, or complex interconnected systems.

  • A background in military service and especially in the Cyber / IT domain is a strong plus.


Core Qualities

  • The "Stark" Factor: You are comfortable with ambiguity, thrive under pressure, and possess the "founder's grit" needed to build a department from a blank sheet of paper.

  • Structured Energy: You bring a contagious energy to the team while maintaining the rigorous organizational structure necessary to execute complex roadmaps.

  • Mission-First Mindset: You are obsessed with customer outcomes. You don’t consider a project finished until the customer has achieved their mission objective.

  • Risk Sentinel: You have an uncanny ability to spot problems, dependencies, and organizational tensions well before others notice them.

  • Crisp Communicator: You effortlessly distill complex technical and strategic contexts into simple, compelling written and spoken communication.

  • Trusted Operator: You build trust rapidly, operating with the highest levels of discretion, integrity, and a low-ego attitude.

  • Owner’s Mindset: You move with urgency, take full ownership, and relentlessly follow through until the result is delivered.


Tools & Mindset

  • Proficient with modern tools like Jira, Confluence, and advanced planning/reporting platforms.

  • Highly proactive, exceptionally structured, and fully capable of independently driving complex projects to the finish line.

  • Able to partner closely with engineers, understanding their needs and matching it with needs of our military customers.

  • A mature understanding of handling classified information and supporting B2G (Business-to-Government) customers.

You report to our CTO and are the voice of the platform in engineering decisions. How we build and run things Everything runs on Kubernetes (Azure AKS), deployed with Helm and GitOps/Flux. All infrastructure is Terraform, applied through CI. CI/CD for every service on GitLab Managed services wherever they keep life simple: Postgres, OpenSearch, Redis, blob storage. Python everywhere: read and fix application code when that is where the fix belongs. Security is routine: automated scanning in every pipeline, regular external pentests, quarterly backup and disaster-recovery tests. You decide how this platform evolves, you keep it secure, observable and cost-efficient, and you extend it as the product grows. Most recently that meant an LLM gateway with region failover in front of our Azure OpenAI deployments, and performing GPU capacity planning for our own models.

You set your own roadmap. Infrastructure at Workist is run as quarterly themes that you propose, make the case for and deliver, and roughly a third of your time goes to whatever the week brings: an incident, a pentest finding, a developer whose deployment is stuck and needs a second pair of eyes. You report to our CTO and are the voice of the platform in engineering decisions.


How we build and run things

  • Everything runs on Kubernetes (Azure AKS), deployed with Helm and GitOps/Flux. All infrastructure is Terraform, applied through CI.

  • CI/CD for every service on GitLab

  • Managed services wherever they keep life simple: Postgres, OpenSearch, Redis, blob storage. We self-host only where it clearly pays off.

  • Two clouds: Azure as our primary cloud, AWS for search and mail ingestion.

  • Python everywhere: read and fix application code when that is where the fix belongs.

  • Security is routine: automated scanning in every pipeline, regular external pentests, quarterly backup and disaster-recovery tests.


Your responsibilities

Own the platform

  • Own the architecture of our cloud environments across Azure and AWS: how subscriptions, networks, identities and environments are structured and stay isolated

  • Design and deliver the platform capabilities the product needs next, from GPU capacity and an LLM gateway to new environments

  • Set the standard for how we run Kubernetes and our managed data services: capacity planned ahead of growth, changes and upgrades rolled out safely and routinely, costs kept in check

Keep it quiet

  • Own the security posture end to end: least-privilege access, network isolation, findings from scanners and pentests, and a patch cadence that runs itself. Be a technical counterpart for audits and security questionnaires

  • Own observability and alerting so that every alert is worth acting on, and lead the response to platform incidents including the follow-up fixes

  • Run quarterly backup/restore and disaster-recovery tests, and close what they reveal

Make the team faster

  • Own the path from merge request to production: fast builds, reliable deployments, environments and access on demand

  • Build the infrastructure behind our AI models: the LLM gateway, model deployments with region failover, GPU capacity, and whatever the next model needs


What this looked like recently: a Redis instance that silently dropped half of its new TCP connections and took the Celery workers down with it, region failover and load balancing for our Azure OpenAI deployments, moving our clusters from nginx ingress to the Kubernetes Gateway API.


Your profile

We're looking for a professional team player who thrives in an environment where we share knowledge openly and push each other to deliver the best possible outcome. What you bring:


  • You have run production infrastructure for years, ideally as the person who owned it end to end rather than one of many in a large ops team

  • Kubernetes and Terraform in production: cluster upgrades, Helm, GitOps, and infrastructure as code for a whole cloud estate

  • Production experience on Azure or AWS. Most of our estate is Azure, so an AWS background works if you are willing to go deep on Azure.

  • Security as a habit: you have run patch management, handled pentest findings and designed least-privilege access, and you prioritise findings pragmatically

  • You write clearly: runbooks, incident write-ups and architecture decisions that others can follow

raw.description:
Your mission

As our Application Security Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping and strengthening the security of our products and platforms. Working closely with highly skilled engineering, platform, and security teams, you will help build secure, resilient, and trusted software while driving a security-first culture across the organization. This is an opportunity to make a measurable impact on modern products, influence security strategy, and continuously develop your expertise in a collaborative and innovative environment.

  • Drive product security across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Perform threat modeling, architecture reviews, and security assessments for applications, APIs, and distributed systems.
  • Identify, assess, prioritize, and support the remediation of security vulnerabilities.
  • Integrate, operate, and continuously improve security tooling within CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, DAST, SCA, dependency scanning, and secrets-scanning solutions.
  • Define, promote, and support secure coding standards and security best practices across engineering teams.
  • Review and advise on authentication, authorization, identity management, secrets management, and service-to-service communication designs.
  • Support penetration testing activities, conduct targeted security testing, and drive remediation efforts.
  • Contribute to security policies, standards, and security awareness initiatives.
  • Partner closely with software engineers, architects, and platform teams to embed security into development processes and strengthen our DevSecOps culture.


Your profile

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Security, Application Security, Software Security, Secure Software Development, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of secure software development practices and common application security vulnerabilities.
  • Proven experience performing threat modeling, architecture reviews, code reviews, and application security assessments.
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, dependency-scanning, and secrets-scanning tools.
  • Strong knowledge of application security, API security, and distributed-system security.
  • Experience securing authentication, authorization, and identity-related workflows.
  • Solid understanding of OWASP, CWE, security testing methodologies, and modern security engineering practices.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and applying DevSecOps principles.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with software engineering, platform, and DevOps teams.
  • Fluent English skills are required; German language skills are a plus.
Nice to have
  • Development experience in C#, .NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or similar programming languages.
  • Experience securing cloud-native applications and services in Azure and/or AWS environments.
  • Relevant security certifications such as OSCP, CSSLP, OSWE, or GIAC Secure Development certifications.
  • Experience working in agile software development environments.

title: Staff Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><p>Wolt’s AdTech &amp; Promotions team is building the systems that power how restaurants and brands grow on our platform. From campaign creation to optimization and forecasting, we develop tools that help advertisers make smarter decisions and drive measurable results. As we expand our offering, we are investing in new capabilities that combine real-time data, scalable systems, and intuitive user experiences to unlock the next phase of growth.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Staff Engineer</strong> to join the Wolt AdTech &amp; Promotions organization, who can drive technical direction across this space and help us build reliable, scalable systems that description: OUR MISSION To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head. What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service. In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million. And we’re a long way from done! CAMPAIGN OPERATIONS @ CARWOW The Campaign Operations team sits at the heart of Carwow’s OEM and Media business. We turn ambitious commercial ideas into high-quality digital advertising campaigns that deliver strong results for our clients and meaningful revenue for Carwow. We work closely with Sales, Product, Data, Marketing, Engineering and external partners to deliver campaigns across Carwow’s automotive media portfolio. Our mission is to make campaign delivery accurate, efficient and scalable while continuously improving how we work through better processes, technology and innovation. YOUR MISSION As Campaign Operations Manager, your mission will be to own the successful delivery and optimisation of digital advertising campaigns from initial planning through to post-campaign analysis. You’ll ensure campaigns launch accurately, deliver against their objectives and provide an excellent experience for our clients and internal teams. You’ll proactively solve delivery challenges, identify opportunities to maximise revenue and use data to turn campaign performance into valuable insights. Success in this role means consistently delivering high-quality campaigns while helping Campaign Operations become smarter, more efficient and increasingly scalable. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Own the end-to-end delivery of digital advertising campaigns, from planning and setup through to optimisation, reporting and post-campaign analysis. Ensure campaigns are implemented accurately, launched on time and delivered in line with agreed objectives. Monitor campaign performance and proactively optimise activity to improve delivery and results. Troubleshoot campaign issues, resolve blockers and minimise delivery and revenue risk. Produce high-quality campaign reports and post-campaign analysis decks that translate performance data into clear, actionable insights. Present campaign performance, findings and recommendations to internal stakeholders and external clients when required. Build strong working relationships with Sales, Product, Data, Marketing, Engineering and external partners. Identify commercial opportunities, including campaign upweights, extensions and improvements that could deliver additional value for clients and Carwow. Continuously review Campaign Operations processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy and scalability. Support the adoption of automation, AI and new technology across Campaign Operations while maintaining strong quality-control standards. KEY REQUIREMENTS Experience managing and delivering digital advertising campaigns within a publisher, media owner, agency or ad-tech environment. Strong understanding of digital advertising operations, campaign setup, optimisation, delivery and reporting. Experience using an ad server or campaign management platform, ideally Google Ad Manager. Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, stakeholders and deadlines at the same time. Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn campaign data into clear insights and recommendations. A proactive approach to identifying risks, resolving problems and improving campaign performance. Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering accurate, high-quality work. Confident communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain campaign performance clearly. A commercially minded approach, with an understanding of how effective campaign management supports revenue and client retention. A collaborative, adaptable mindset and an interest in improving processes through technology, automation and AI. Previous involvement in process-improvement, automation or AI projects. WHY THIS MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU Campaign Operations is a fast-paced, high-pressure environment, with responsibility for delivering commercially important campaigns against tight deadlines and changing priorities.
