title: Associate Director, Supply Chain
description: <p><strong>Associate Director, Supply Chain</strong></p> <p><strong>Company:</strong>&nbsp; Cycle Pharmaceuticals Ltd</p> <p><strong>Position Summary: </strong>This is a full-time position leading our Supply Chain department, working in our Cambridge office on a hybrid basis (minimum 3 days in the office).&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Opportunity</strong></p> <p>We have an exciting opportunity for an Associate Director of Supply Chain to lead our supply chain function within the business. You’ll combine your strategic ownership with hands-on execution shaping our global supply chain strategy ensuring, reliable, compliant and cost-effective product supply to patients through an outsourced partner network.</p> <p>This includes managing relationships with contract manufacturers, packaging and logistics providers, distributors, serialisation partners and other critical external suppliers to ensure a resilient, compliant and responsive supply chain.</p> <p>Reporting to the Chief Operations and Regulatory Officer, you will work closely with Executive Leadership and colleagues across Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Commercial and Finance, as well as a diverse network of external partners. You will also lead and develop the Supply Chain function, creating the capability, relationships and ways of working needed to support continued growth.</p> <p>This is a role for a commercially minded and collaborative supply chain leader who enjoys operating in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. You will have the autonomy to shape strategy, solve complex supply challenges and drive continuous improvement, while helping build a supply chain capable of supporting the next stage of the company's growth.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Our Company&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At Cycle Pharmaceuticals, we believe that <strong>Every Single Patient Matters</strong>. This is at the heart of why we work. As we look to grow, we’re now looking for people to join our team who share our vision. We know that life-changing treatments need life-improving product support to match, because when you put the two together, great things can happen.</p> <p>Our core focus areas include rare metabolic, oncology, immunological, and neurological genetic conditions, where we improve existing drugs, repurpose them for new uses, and bring generics back to market. Using cutting-edge drug delivery technologies, we enhance the efficiency of treatments, offering patients greater freedom and choice.</p> <p>If you want to know more about what we do then, why not check out our website below and look at some of our patient stories:&nbsp;<a href="https://cyclepharma.com/patient-advocacy/patient-stories/">Patient Stories - Cycle Pharma</a></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing in this role:</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>Supply Chain Strategy, Planning and Operations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and execute supply chain strategies aligned to commercial priorities, product launches, lifecycle management and the organisation’s broader growth ambitions.</li> <li>Provide clear, evidence-based, risk-adjusted recommendations on supply priorities, inventory trade-offs, supplier performance and escalation requirements, enabling timely, transparent and commercially informed decision-making.</li> <li>Provide strategic oversight of the end-to-end supply chain, including demand and supply planning, inventory management, manufacturing scheduling, distribution and product availability, ensuring a reliable and responsive supply network.</li> <li>Lead the Sales &amp; Operations Planning (S&amp;OP) process, bringing together commercial forecasts, customer demand, inventory strategy and manufacturing capacity to create a clear, aligned view of supply and demand. Proactively identify, communicate and mitigate emerging risks.</li> <li>Establish and optimise inventory policies and supply strategies that balance product availability, supply resilience, risk and working capital requirements.</li> <li>Define and maintain meaningful supply chain KPIs and performance measures, using data and insight to identify opportunities, strengthen accountability and drive continuous improvement across the supply network.</li> <li>Support business development initiatives, new product introductions and other growth initiatives, assessing supply chain requirements and developing scalable, compliant and fit-for-purpose supply solutions.</li> <li>Own the annual Supply Chain budget, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, optimise costs and deliver value while maintaining regulatory compliance, supply resilience and product availability.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Supply Chain Governance and Operational Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead strategic relationships with contract manufacturers, packaging providers, logistics partners, distributors, serialization providers and other critical supply chain partners, ensuring clear accountability and delivery against agreed service, quality and business requirements.</li> <li>Establish and maintain effective supplier governance, including structured performance reviews, service-level management, quality oversight, issue resolution and improvement plans, ensuring external partners consistently meet expectations.</li> <li>Work closely with Quality Assurance and relevant functions to ensure the external supply network operates in accordance with applicable GxP, GDP, DSCSA and other regulatory requirements.</li> <li>Lead the resolution and escalation of complex supply, quality, compliance and operational issues, coordinating internal teams and external partners to minimise business impact and protect product availability.</li> <li>Drive the development of scalable supply chain processes, improving visibility, data quality, operational efficiency and ways of working as the organisation and product portfolio grow.</li> <li>Provide governance and oversight of critical supply chain systems and data, including ERP, serialization, GS1 and inventory management platforms, ensuring robust master data, system integrity and reliable reporting.</li> <li>Establish a culture of accountability and continuous improvement across the external supply network, using supplier performance insights, operational data and emerging risks to identify and deliver sustainable improvements.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>People Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and develop the Supply Chain function, setting clear priorities, expectations and ways of working while creating a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement and high performance.</li> <li>Build team capability and succession strength through coaching, mentoring and targeted development, ensuring the function has the skills, expertise and capacity to support the organisation’s future growth.</li> <li>Develop strong, collaborative relationships with senior stakeholders, providing clear supply chain insight and challenge to support informed business decisions and representing Supply Chain effectively across cross-functional leadership and governance forums.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The following skills and experience will be important in helping you to succeed </strong><strong>in this role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Degree (or equivalent experience) in Supply Chain Management, Business Operations, or Life Sciences.</li> <li>Significant pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare supply chain experience, including leadership responsibility for outsourced manufacturing and distribution networks.</li> <li>Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across cross-functional teams and build strong internal and external relationships.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong understanding of demand planning, inventory management, contract manufacturing, logistics, supplier management, and supply chain compliance.</li> <li>Knowledge of GDP, DSCSA, serialisation, and global pharmaceutical supply chain regulations.</li> <li>Experience leading cross-functional projects, product launches, and business-critical supply chain initiatives.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and manage complex external partnerships.</li> <li>Excellent analytical, leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What can we offer to you:</strong></p> <p>In addition to being part of a great team and doing things that will make a real difference to patients’ lives, you will enjoy all the benefits that brings:</p> <ul> <li>A collaborative high performing work environment</li> <li>Performance based bonus</li> <li>Opportunity to join a fast growing and ambitious business</li> <li>Company pension scheme</li> <li>100% employer paid membership for Private Health Insurance</li> <li>Life and Critical Illness Insurance</li> <li>Corporate Gym membership</li> <li>Regular team building events and an agile working environment</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Diversity and Inclusion statement:</strong></p> <p><em>At Cycle Pharmaceuticals, we are committed to creating an inclusive, respectful, positive and diverse workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, gender, age,&nbsp;</em><em>disability, or any other protected characteristic. We actively support and embrace diversity, and we are working to build a team that reflects a wide range of backgrounds and perspectives.</em></p> <p><em>We value your unique contributions and encourage you to join us in shaping a more inclusive future. If you require any reasonable adjustments - whether during the application process or in the workplace - we will be happy to support your needs. At Cycle, equality, inclusion, and respect are at the core of everything we do. We fully comply with all applicable employment laws, including those related to non-discrimination, work authorization, and employment eligibility verification.</em></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director, Mobility Partnerships
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Material Bank is the world’s largest material marketplace for the architecture and design industry. Operating in 37 countries, our platform has become the standard for design professionals around the globe. Every day, Material Bank connects thousands of designers with tens of thousands of materials from leading brands. Material Bank is the fastest and most powerful way for design professionals to search, sample, and specify materials.</p></div><p>As Director, Mobility Partnerships, you will lead Material Bank’s expansion into the global mobility interiors market, building strategic partnerships with leading brands across automotive, aviation, and marine. This is not a traditional sales role—it is an opportunity to establish a new vertical by leveraging deep industry expertise, trusted relationships, and commercial acumen.</p> <p>You will be responsible for identifying, engaging, and securing founding brand partners while serving as Material Bank’s representative within a highly specialized industry. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a>&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information visit&nbsp;<a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and&nbsp;<a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>More About&nbsp;The&nbsp;Role</strong>&nbsp;<br>This role&nbsp;sits within the&nbsp;Corporate&nbsp;Sectors&nbsp;and Public&nbsp;Affairs&nbsp;teams&nbsp;at Burson as a Social &amp; Content&nbsp;Strategist&nbsp;(Account Director). You will&nbsp;be&nbsp;working&nbsp;as part of a global social media team for a leading technology company,&nbsp;as well as supporting&nbsp;other key accounts,&nbsp;creating social-first content for&nbsp;Instagram, TikTok,&nbsp;LinkedIn,&nbsp;Facebook&nbsp;and&nbsp;X.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>You will&nbsp;be responsible for&nbsp;developing social&nbsp;strategies that<u>:</u>&nbsp;connect audience&nbsp;behaviour&nbsp;with brand&nbsp;objectives.&nbsp;You will partner&nbsp;closely&nbsp;with&nbsp;creative&nbsp;teams, account leaders, and clients to guide the direction of&nbsp;campaigns&nbsp;across platforms.&nbsp;Your work will influence&nbsp;content planning, creative development,&nbsp;community engagement, and measurement approaches.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are looking for someone who&nbsp;is passionate &nbsp;&nbsp;about&nbsp;social platforms,&nbsp;embraces&nbsp;new&nbsp;content&nbsp;formats<u> </u>and with strong client management skills and the flexibility to work across different types of social platforms.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Develop and implement robust, data-driven social media&nbsp;and digital engagement&nbsp;strategies by conducting in-depth&nbsp;reputational&nbsp;analysis, trend forecasting, and&nbsp;stakeholder&nbsp;/ audience&nbsp;mapping, ensuring these strategies are not only clear and compelling but also directly aligned with overarching business&nbsp;objectives&nbsp;and measurable KPIs.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Lead&nbsp;and optimise strategic social platform planning for both large-scale, time-bound campaigns and continuous 'always-on' engagement initiatives, meticulously defining channel-specific content ecosystems, targeting parameters, and maximising reach and impact across the relevant digital landscape.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Translate performance data, intelligence, and&nbsp;stakeholder&nbsp;sentiment into actionable strategic recommendations that directly inspire and inform innovative creative development, campaign optimisation, and future content planning.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Persuasively present complex strategic frameworks, insights, and actionable plans to both internal stakeholders and external clients, instilling confidence and securing buy-in through clear, compelling communication and a proven executive presence.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>At the client level:&nbsp;Leverage&nbsp;our suite of tools to&nbsp;anticipate&nbsp;threats&nbsp;and inform innovative strategic pivots&nbsp;for our clients&nbsp;that&nbsp;build&nbsp;reputation, strategic&nbsp;relevance&nbsp;and competitive advantage.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>At the practice level:&nbsp;Proactively&nbsp;monitor&nbsp;and interpret evolving social media trends, platform evolutions, and shifts in audience behaviour to&nbsp;identify&nbsp;emerging opportunities&nbsp;for our clients, teams and to keep Burson ahead of the curve.&nbsp;You will join a&nbsp;vibrant&nbsp;community of Social&nbsp;&amp; Content&nbsp;contributors across our London office, working together to grow and innovate the offer.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience that contributes to success </strong></p> <ul> <li>Embed&nbsp;seamlessly into our Corporate and Public Affairs&nbsp;team, working across our specialisms to understand our clients and the&nbsp;factors shaping reputation across&nbsp;stakeholders,&nbsp;media,&nbsp;policy, regulation, issues and more.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Collaborate&nbsp;with creative teams, guiding the development of concepts and content designed to authentically connect with and deeply resonate&nbsp;with target stakeholders,<u> </u>ensuring messaging is&nbsp;reputationally&nbsp;relevant and highly engaging.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Creating&nbsp;effective&nbsp;content briefs&nbsp;for&nbsp;our design team,&nbsp;developing copy and making recommendations on assets&nbsp;and overseeing digital editorial calendars.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Proactively&nbsp;monitor&nbsp;and interpret evolving social media trends, platform evolutions, and shifts in audience behaviour to&nbsp;identify&nbsp;emerging opportunities,&nbsp;anticipate&nbsp;competitive&nbsp;threats, and inform innovative strategic pivots that&nbsp;maintain&nbsp;brand&nbsp;relevance and competitive advantage.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Articulate and persuasively present complex strategic frameworks, insights, and actionable plans to both internal stakeholders and external clients, instilling confidence and securing buy-in through clear, compelling communication and a proven executive presence.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Creating content briefs to feed into our design and editing team, developing&nbsp;copy&nbsp;and making recommendations on assets and content structure&nbsp;and overseeing the management&nbsp;social calendar across multiple regions for a global LinkedIn company page&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Managing client communications including leading content development workstreams, updating WIPs and calendars, internal communication with colleagues&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our &nbsp;<a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/recruitment-privacy-notice">Recruitment Privacy Policy. </a>California residents should read our <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">California Recruitment Privacy Notice. </a>This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Graduate - Scale Space
description: <h1>Graduate Programme — Scale Space</h1> <ul data-spread="false"> <li>Are you torn between the excitement of start-ups and the stability of corporate life?</li> <li>Are you keen to continue learning and developing skills whilst experiencing how to build businesses?</li> <li>Are you looking for a role that will offer the opportunity to experience first-hand how a growing business operates, while being supported to take ownership of work that matters?</li> </ul> <p class="isSelectedEnd">If this sounds like you and you are up for the challenge, we would love to hear from you.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We are looking to hire high-energy, entrepreneurial and value-adding graduate talent to join Blenheim Chalcot in a role dedicated entirely to<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><strong>Scale Space</strong>, one of the businesses within the Blenheim Chalcot portfolio.</p> <h2>ABOUT US</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">At Blenheim Chalcot, we invest more than just funds. We invest our knowledge and experience, our ideas and infrastructure. Our ventures are at the forefront of a multitude of industries being disrupted by digital, including FinTech, EdTech, GovTech, Media, Sport, Charity and more.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We are highly entrepreneurial and seek opportunities where digital technologies can disrupt major markets. Ventures we have built include ClearScore, Salary Finance, Modulr and the Rajasthan Royals cricket team.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Many of the companies within the portfolio have materialised from ideas conceived and launched by us, and we have over 4,000 employees supporting their growth and development. Our assets under management stand at more than £1.8bn and total portfolio revenue is over £500 million.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We work closely with investment and strategic partners including PayPal, FIS, L&amp;G, Tencent, Experian, Google, Worldpay, Imperial College and some of the leading venture capital and private equity companies internationally.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Our central team, Venture Builder Services (VBS), exists to support our ventures to be successful quickly, sustainably and with access to best-practice tools, solutions and expertise. We provide a range of services to help new businesses get off the ground, including technology, growth, talent, finance, legal and tax.</p> <h2>IMPACT BEYOND PROFIT</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">15% of our partnerships and ventures are charities. These include the British Asian Trust, Babyzone and OnSide Youth Zones. In the same way that we support our ventures, our Partners provide direct hands-on support to these charities by being active board members and offering expert advice.</p> <h2>ABOUT SCALE SPACE</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Scale Space is a community and workspace designed to bring together ambitious businesses, entrepreneurs, scale-ups and innovators.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Based in White City, Scale Space provides more than just flexible workspace. It creates an environment where growing businesses can connect, collaborate and access the networks, expertise and opportunities they need to scale.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">The team works across community, events, partnerships, operations and customer experience to ensure that members receive a high-quality experience while helping to build a connected and ambitious business community.</p> <h2>THE GRADUATE OPPORTUNITY</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">Joining Blenheim Chalcot as a Graduate, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced and progressive environment while working exclusively with<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span><strong>Scale Space</strong>.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You will be embedded within the Scale Space team and contribute to meaningful projects across the business, while benefiting from Blenheim Chalcot's learning, development and employee benefits.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">For you as a graduate, this opportunity involves:</p> <ul data-spread="true"> <li><strong>Dedicated to Scale Space</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>– although you will be employed by Blenheim Chalcot, your role will sit fully within Scale Space. Your day-to-day work, projects and objectives will be focused entirely on supporting Scale Space and its growth, giving you the opportunity to build deep experience within a fast-moving and entrepreneurial business.</li> <li><strong>Training &amp; Development</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>– we pride ourselves on having an intentional and continuous learning and development culture at Blenheim Chalcot. You will have access to BC learning and development opportunities designed to strengthen your core professional, commercial and leadership skills, while applying that learning directly to your work at Scale Space. You will learn by doing, taking on real responsibility and developing quickly within the Scale Space team.</li> <li><strong>Early Careers Development</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>– as a BC graduate, you will have access to structured development opportunities designed for those early in their careers. These will support your professional growth while your substantive role remains fully dedicated to Scale Space.</li> <li><strong>Graduate Community</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>– you will be part of the wider BC graduate community, with access to relevant learning sessions, networking opportunities and socials. This community is intended to support your development and connection with fellow graduates; your substantive role and day-to-day responsibilities will remain entirely within Scale Space.</li> <li><strong>Accountability</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>– you will be given meaningful responsibility from the outset and supported to take ownership of work that matters. Rather than rotating between businesses, you will build continuity and depth within Scale Space and see the direct impact of your work on the business, its members and the wider community.</li> </ul> <h2>ARE YOU BC?</h2> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We are not expecting you to have worked in start-ups before or to have studied a tech-related degree. For us, it is about hiring the right person and their potential, not just their experience.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">As such, we are looking for graduates from any discipline. Different areas of expertise bring valuable new perspectives.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">We look for some key fundamentals in people when hiring into the BC Group. We look for people who are:</p> <ul data-spread="true"> <li><strong>Curious</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>– people in BC are inquisitive. They want to understand ‘why’ and consider whether there is a better approach rather than simply accepting ‘it’s how we’ve always done it’. Given our ethos is all about disrupting industries with new methods and products, curiosity is at the heart of what we do.</li> <li><strong>‘Doers’</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>– we are a community of proactive self-starters. We will provide full support to our graduates, but we look for people who can use their initiative, take ownership and drive work forward on a daily basis.</li> <li><strong>Flexible Mindset</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>– working in a growth business environment is ambiguous, diverse and, at times, chaotic by definition. Being adaptable and recognising the importance of flexibility in order to add value in a constantly evolving company is vital.</li> <li><strong>Enthusiasm</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp;</span>– you do not need to be a ‘techy’ at heart to work in our environment. We invest our knowledge and experience, our ideas and infrastructure. Our ventures are at the forefront of a multitude of industries being disrupted by digital including FinTech, EdTech, GovTech, Media, Sport, Charity and more. We are highly entrepreneurial and seek opportunities where digital technologies can disrupt major markets - ventures we have built include ClearScore, Salary Finance, Modulr and the Rajasthan Royals cricket team.</p> <p>Many of the companies within the portfolio have materialised from ideas conceived and launched by us, and we have over 4,000 employees to support their growth and development. Our assets under management stand at more than £1.8bn and total portfolio revenue is over £500 million.</p> <p>We work closely with investment and strategic partners ranging from Paypal, FIS, L&amp;G, Tencent, Experian, Google, WorldPay, Imperial College and some of the leading venture capital and private equity companies internationally.</p> <p>Our central team, Venture Builder Services (VBS), exists to support our ventures to be successful quickly, sustainably and with access to the best practice tools, solutions, and expertise. We provide a range of services to help new business get off the ground, including technology, growth (marketing and sales), talent, finance, legal and tax.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;IMPACT BEYOND PROFIT</strong></p> <p>15% of our partnerships and ventures are charities. These include the British Asian Trust,&nbsp;Babyzone and Onside Youth Zones. In the same way that we support our ventures, our Partners provide direct hands-on support to these charities by being active board members and offering expert advice.</p> <p>ABOUT BABYZONE</p> <p>Babyzone is&nbsp;an innovative and fast-growing UK early childhood charity. It runs free, open-access community hubs for families with children aged 0-5 in areas of high deprivation, bringing together services, programmes and partners to improve outcomes for young children and their families.</p> <p>&nbsp;<strong>THE GRADUATE OPPORTUNITY</strong></p> <p>Joining Blenheim Chalcot as a Graduate, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced and progressive environment while working exclusively with Babyzone. You will have access to BC learning and development opportunities designed to strengthen your core professional, commercial and leadership skills, while applying that learning directly to your work at Babyzone. For us, it is about hiring the right person and their potential, not just their experience. As such, we are looking for graduates from any discipline – different areas of expertise are great for new perspectives.&nbsp;</p> <p>We look for some key fundamentals in people when hiring into the BC Group. This is a fully remote position for those residing in London.</p> <p>Keeper's cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organisations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and be responsible for building pipeline and channel revenue with high performance partners.</p> <p><strong>About Keeper</strong></p> <p>Keeper Security is a leading cybersecurity software company that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in more than 150 countries. Keeper delivers a powerful zero-trust and zero-knowledge solution built to meet the stringent requirements of public sector IT environments. Its flagship offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects users, devices and critical infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized in the Gartner® Magic QuadrantTM for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper combines robust compliance with unmatched visibility and control. With industry-leading certifications, Keeper provides the security assurance public sector organizations require. About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Director of Finance Business Partnering to join us at Pleo. In this role, you'll lead our entire Finance Business Partnering (FBP) team, driving strategic decisions, financial performance, and resource allocation across our entire business - connecting Go-To-Market (GTM), Product & Offering, and Enablement into one coherent financial lens. As we scale, you will establish a new standard for strategic finance, balancing rigorous challenges with valued operational support to the business.
If you're excited about bringing commercial and strategic insight to high-growth teams, developing a talented finance team, and leveraging modern data and AI workflows to transform decision-making, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our CFO and work closely with C-suite and senior leaders across the entire organization (including the Chief Revenue Officer, Chief Product & Technology Officer and Chief People Officer and their respective leadership teams). You will directly lead and develop our team of Finance Business Partners, fostering a culture of ownership and strategic impact.
You’ll also operate as a close partner to the Director of Finance Platform to ensure Business Finance and Finance Platform operate with unified standards, zero friction, and one coherent voice.

What you’ll be doing

As Director of Finance Business Partnering, you will:

  • Drive Strategic Finance Partnering Across All Functions: Serve as a trusted strategic peer to C-level executives, translating operational and commercial realities into robust financial plans.

  • Bridge Product, Monetization & GTM: Connect product roadmap investments and feature choices directly to monetization, commercial deal structures, and go-to-market execution.

  • Lead Financial Planning & Performance Support: Drive annual budgeting, scenario modeling, resource allocation, and forecasting cycles across all business areas, shifting conversations from backward-looking reporting to forward-looking, decision-oriented action.

  • Lead & Evolve the FBP Team: Coach, mentor, and elevate a well-performing team of Finance Business Partners, setting clear capability standards, and fostering a curious, data- and impact-driven culture.

  • Leverage Data & Modern Workflows: Practical application of modern BI, analytics, and available AI tools to enhance and streamline commercial modeling, reduce manual work, and deliver faster insights.


To put things into context, we are actively focusing on rapid and sustainable topline growth, efficiency, and connecting product investment directly to bottom-line growth. You can expect to work with modern commercial data, BI, and AI-driven workflows alongside standard ERP, CRM, and FP&A tools.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Broad Finance Business Partnering Leadership: Senior experience leading finance business partnering across multiple major functions (GTM, Product, and/or central enablement functions) within a SaaS or scale-up environment.

  • Proven Finance Business Partner excellence: Proven track record designing and implementing best-in-class FBP frameworks across SaaS/scale-up environments. You know how to best define end-to-end partnerships across GTM, Product, and Enablement, establishing clear financial insights, decision-making, and accountability while leveraging modern data and AI workflows to elevate team output.

  • SaaS & Subscription Economics Fluency: Deep fluency in recurring revenue drivers, growth/efficiency trade-offs, and core SaaS metrics (ARR, CAC/LTV, retention, payback, sales capacity, pipeline, and product margin economics).

  • C-Suite Influence & Communication: Proven ability to partner with and challenge executive leadership, framing choices clearly and turning complex data into structured, actionable guidance.

  • People Leadership & Capability Building: A track record of assessing, coaching, and developing an existing finance team, helping individuals elevate their strategic impact through organizational change.

  • Strategic Planning & Commercial Judgment: High proficiency in budgeting, forecasting, scenario modeling, and business case development in fast-paced, ambiguous scale-up environments.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You want to lead end-to-end finance business partnering with senior business leaders, directly shaping how product, commercial, and operational strategy translate into resource allocation and growth.

  • You enjoy building and mentoring teams, establishing high standards, and helping finance professionals grow into strategic business partners.

  • You thrive in fast-paced scale-up environments, turning ambiguity into structured, data-led choices without needing rigid enterprise playbooks.


How do you drive impact:

In your first 6-12 months at Pleo, you will step in to stabilize and elevate our entire Finance Business Partnering function. You’ll start building trust across C-level leadership, and establishing a seamless interface with Finance Platform. As you’ll settle, you’ll connect our product roadmap decisions to commercial execution, will drive higher standards for executive decision-making and lastly, you’ll build a high-performing FBP team equipped for Pleo’s next stage of international scale.

The location

Please note: We can hire on hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert (Denmark, United Kingdom, Spain and Portugal) but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.


Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • We offer 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards)

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  • Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  • Hiring Manager: A 45-minute chat with our CFO about the role and needs.

  • Pleo Peer Interviews: Two separated 60-minute Peer chats with our Senior stakeholders with some real life case scenarios.

  • Final Stage: A 30-minute chat with our CRO and our CPO.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a senior Finance leader, we received a high volume of applications, but only a selective group were invited to an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI, it’s a big focus for us internally too - but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. Including links to your previous companies' websites is also a huge help!

  • Application care: Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. Take time to tailor your responses to show how your experience specifically intersects with broad business finance, commercial operations, product economics, and team development.

  • Profile to role fit: For this role specifically, candidates who lack experience partnering across multiple business functions, or who are narrow functional specialists without SaaS unit economics fluency, often miss the mark. We need someone who can lead across GTM, Product, and Enablement, challenging executives and elevating business decisions, not just traditional P&L oversight.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

description: About MUBI MUBI is a global streaming service, production company and film distributor dedicated to elevating great cinema. To make this possible, we create, curate, acquire and champion visionary films, bringing them to audiences all over the world. We have a team of brilliant, dedicated and passionate people to help bring our mission to life. From London to New York, Istanbul to Paris, and Berlin to Mexico - we work together to realize MUBI’s vision. That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere. About the Role MUBI's web platform is where millions of people discover, read about and watch films. It's a streaming player, a curated catalogue and an editorial publication in one, and it has to feel fast and considered in every one of the countries we operate in. We are seeking a Senior Engineer to join our Frontend team. In this role, you will contribute to the architecture and implementation of MUBI’s website, serving millions of cinema enthusiasts across the globe. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role reporting to our Head of Frontend. You will partner closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, video CDN engineers, and backend teams to craft high-performance, seamless digital experiences - from our curated discovery channels to streaming platform capabilities and original editorial publications. We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 in-office days if you're near one of our sites. Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish. Where you’ll have impact: Build the web experience. Design and implement features across the platform, from discovery and catalogue to the player and our editorial pages, in React, TypeScript and Next.js. You'll own them end to end: technical scoping, implementation, automated testing (unit, integration, E2E), deployment and observability. Make playback feel effortless. Work directly on media player integrations, adaptive streaming experiences, dynamic video previews, and high-framerate media components. Keep it fast. Analyze and continuously optimize client-side bundle size, Core Web Vitals, server-side rendering performance, and edge caching strategies. Raise the bar. Set the standard for code quality, testing and review on the team, and help other engineers get there. Use AI where it pays off. Experiment with coding agents, share the prompts and skills that work, and push for measurable gains over novelty. What you’ll bring: 8+ Years of Frontend Experience. Proven track record building and operating complex, consumer-facing web applications at scale using React, Next.js/SSR, and TypeScript. Expert knowledge of the DOM, browser rendering optimization, web performance profiling tools, state management strategies, and HTTP/media protocol fundamentals. Understanding of how the media is delivered to and played in modern web browsers. Familiarity with the features and problems of technologies like HLS, DASH, Widevine, FairPlay, CORS. Championing AI adoption across the team - experimenting with coding agents, sharing reusable prompts/skills, and pushing for measurable gains rather than novelty. Committed to maintainable code, test-driven development (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress/Playwright), and strong CI/CD practices. Clear and articulate technical communication in an agile, cross-functional engineering organization. We use Slack & Linear. An independent mindset and genuine curiosity about how the product is used - you generate your own questions rather than waiting for a brief. Nice to have: Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment (e.g. startup or scale-up). Experience leading or contributing to cross-functional projects with teams such as Product, Marketing, Finance, or Engineering. Experience with design systems and close collaboration with designers. Genuine interest in film and in MUBI's mission. We want to make cinema accessible to everyone. We believe people from different backgrounds bring different ideas that foster innovation and engagement, allowing us to attract great people to develop the best experience for our users. MUBI is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer. About MUBI

MUBI is a global streaming service, production company and film distributor dedicated to elevating great cinema. To make this possible, we create, curate, acquire and champion visionary films, bringing them to audiences all over the world. We have a team of brilliant, dedicated and passionate people to help bring our mission to life. From London to New York, Istanbul to Paris, and Berlin to Mexico - we work together to realize MUBI’s vision.

That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere.

About the Role

MUBI's web platform is where millions of people discover, read about and watch films. It's a streaming player, a curated catalogue and an editorial publication in one, and it has to feel fast and considered in every one of the countries we operate in.

We are seeking a Senior Engineer to join our Frontend team. In this role, you will contribute to the architecture and implementation of MUBI’s website, serving millions of cinema enthusiasts across the globe. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role reporting to our Head of Frontend.

You will partner closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, video CDN engineers, and backend teams to craft high-performance, seamless digital experiences - from our curated discovery channels to streaming platform capabilities and original editorial publications.

We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 in-office days if you're near one of our sites. Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish.

Where you’ll have impact:

  • Build the web experience. Design and implement features across the platform, from discovery and catalogue to the player and our editorial pages, in React, TypeScript and Next.js. You'll own them end to end: technical scoping, implementation, automated testing (unit, integration, E2E), deployment and observability.

  • Make playback feel effortless. Work directly on media player integrations, adaptive streaming experiences, dynamic video previews, and high-framerate media components.

  • Keep it fast. Analyze and continuously optimize client-side bundle size, Core Web Vitals, server-side rendering performance, and edge caching strategies.

  • Raise the bar. Set the standard for code quality, testing and review on the team, and help other engineers get there.

  • Use AI where it pays off. Experiment with coding agents, share the prompts and skills that work, and push for measurable gains over novelty.

What you’ll bring:

  • 8+ Years of Frontend Experience. Proven track record building and operating complex, consumer-facing web applications at scale using React, Next.js/SSR, and TypeScript.

  • Expert knowledge of the DOM, browser rendering optimization, web performance profiling tools, state management strategies, and HTTP/media protocol fundamentals.

  • Understanding of how the media is delivered to and played in modern web browsers. Familiarity with the features and problems of technologies like HLS, DASH, Widevine, FairPlay, CORS.

  • Championing AI adoption across the team - experimenting with coding agents, sharing reusable prompts/skills, and pushing for measurable gains rather than novelty.

  • Committed to maintainable code, test-driven development (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress/Playwright), and strong CI/CD practices.

  • Clear and articulate technical communication in an agile, cross-functional engineering organization. We use Slack & Linear.

  • An independent mindset and genuine curiosity about how the product is used - you generate your own questions rather than waiting for a brief.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment (e.g. startup or scale-up).

  • Experience leading or contributing to cross-functional projects with teams such as Product, Marketing, Finance, or Engineering.

  • Experience with design systems and close collaboration with designers.

  • Genuine interest in film and in MUBI's mission.

We want to make cinema accessible to everyone. We believe people from different backgrounds bring different ideas that foster innovation and engagement, allowing us to attract great people to develop the best experience for our users.

MUBI is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer. That means it's our responsibility to ensure that all candidates are not discriminated against in our hiring processes and our employment decisions based on their race, color, religion, nationality or ethnic origin, age, gender identity or expression, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, socioeconomic background, sexual orientation, family or parental status, or any other applicable characteristic.

title: Senior Platform/Dev Ops Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.</p> <p>What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.</p> <p style="padding-left: 40px;">Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating<em> </em>our wins – big and small.</p> <p>Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, <a href="https://www.anaplan.com/careers/">values</a>-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!</p></div><div>We are seeking a Senior Platform Enablement / DevOps Engineer to lead the design, scalability, reliability, and evolution of our enterprise developer platform and cloud-native delivery ecosystem.</div> <div><br>This role combines deep technical expertise with platform strategy, operational leadership, and engineering enablement. You will help define standards, modernize deployment practices, improve developer experience, and drive platform reliability across multi-cloud environments.<br>The ideal candidate has strong experience building enterprise-scale CI/CD platforms, Kubernetes ecosystems, Infrastructure as Code, observability solutions, and developer enablement capabilities.</div> <div><br><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></div> <ul> <li>Architect, build, and evolve scalable platform engineering and DevOps solutions for enterprise engineering teams.</li> <li>Lead the design and implementation of modern CI/CD and GitOps workflows using Jenkins, Kargo, ArgoCD, GitHub, and related tooling.</li> <li>Drive platform standardization, automation, reliability, and self-service engineering capabilities.</li> <li>Design and manage scalable Infrastructure as Code frameworks using Terraform and Terraform Enterprise.</li> <li>Lead Kubernetes platform architecture, Helm-based deployments, and container orchestration best practices.</li> <li>Establish observability standards and operational excellence using Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, and related tooling.</li> <li>Collaborate with engineering, security, cloud, and architecture teams to improve platform capabilities and developer workflows.</li> <li>Mentor engineers and contribute to platform engineering best practices, governance, and technical strategy.</li> <li>Lead incident response, reliability improvements, root cause analysis, and operational maturity initiatives.</li> <li>Improve platform security, scalability, resiliency, and deployment efficiency across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments.</li> <li>Evaluate and introduce new technologies, tooling, and automation opportunities aligned with platform engineering goals.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Required Skills &amp; Experience</strong></div> <ul> <li>Extensive experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE, Cloud Engineering, or related roles.</li> <li>Strong expertise in designing and operating enterprise-scale CI/CD and cloud-native platforms.</li> <li>Deep hands-on experience with: <ul> <li>Jenkins</li> <li>Kargo / ArgoCD</li> <li>GitHub Enterprise</li> <li>Terraform / Terraform Enterprise</li> <li>Kubernetes &amp; Helm</li> <li>Docker</li> </ul> </li> <li>Strong experience with multi-cloud infrastructure: <ul> <li>AWS, Azure, and/or GCP</li> </ul> </li> <li>Strong understanding of observability ecosystems including: <ul> <li>Grafana</li> <li>Loki</li> <li>Prometheus</li> <li>OpenTelemetry tooling</li> </ul> </li> <li>Strong scripting/programming experience with Python, Kotlin, Bash, or similar languages.</li> <li>Experience with build and dependency tooling such as Gradle, Poetry, and UV.</li> <li>Strong understanding of Linux internals, networking, distributed systems, and platform reliability engineering.</li> <li>Experience driving platform modernization and developer enablement initiatives.</li> <li>Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and technical leadership skills.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></div> <ul> <li>Experience building internal developer platforms (IDP) at enterprise scale.</li> <li>Experience with platform governance, security, secrets management, and compliance integration.</li> <li>Exposure to event-driven platform architectures and scalable distributed systems.</li> <li>Experience mentoring teams and influencing engineering standards across organizations.</li> <li>Knowledge of modern platform engineering trends, GitOps practices, and cloud-native ecosystems.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Technologies You’ll Work With</strong></div> <ul> <li>Jenkins, Kargo, ArgoCD</li> <li>GitHub Enterprise</li> <li>Terraform &amp; Terraform Enterprise</li> <li>Docker, Kubernetes, Helm</li> <li>AWS, Azure, GCP</li> <li>Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry</li> <li>Python, Kotlin, Gradle</li> <li>UV, Poetry</li> <li>Linux &amp; Networking</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) </strong></p> <p>We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! </p> <p>We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. &nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer</strong> &nbsp;</p> <p>It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. title: Senior Product Manager
description: Menlo Security is the leader in Browser Security for human and agentic workforces. Our mission is to enable humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely, without compromise. The Menlo Browser Security Platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by stopping threats across the web, documents, and email before they reach the user. With Menlo Agent Runtime Security (MARS), that protection now extends to the AI agents working alongside every employee. Menlo Security is trusted by major global businesses, including Fortune 500 companies and government agencies, to protect their most valuable asset, their data, and is backed by top-tier investors. About the Role Summary Menlo Security is building MARS for Agents (Menlo Agent Runtime Security), our product line for securing autonomous and hybrid AI agents. This is a category still being defined — standards, architecture patterns, and competitive positioning are all forming in real time, with competitors ranging from established network security vendors to a wave of new agent-security startups. We are hiring an experienced Product Manager / Product Owner to take end-to-end ownership of a significant, technically complex area within MARS for Agents. The specific scope will be defined in partnership with the hiring manager based on team needs and the background of the person in this role, and will span identity and security concepts, relevant technical protocols, and platform integration and partnership work. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy day to day, working from strategic direction set by the Head of Product, in an environment that runs agile development at high velocity while actively building the process and rigor needed to scale a growing product line. This is also a team that works the way it builds: AI assistants and LLM-based tools are part of the daily toolkit here — used to synthesize customer and competitive signal, pressure-test requirements, and prototype against MCP clients and agent runtimes before a single line of production code is written. The person in this role will be defining security for a category they are already a fluent, curious user of. Outcomes & KPIs Key Outcome(s) Owned: End-to-end ownership of an assigned surface area of MARS for Agents — across capabilities such as the agent registry, Claude integration, Microsoft Copilot integration, MCP Server, MCP Proxy, and LLM proxy — from researched opportunity, to written requirement, to shipped and supported capability. A current, honest, decision-changing competitive point of view for the agent-security category that the wider go-to-market organization can rely on. Success Metrics / KPIs Roadmap delivery: committed roadmap items for the owned surfaces shipped within the target release window. Requirements quality: Reduction in mid-sprint requirement clarifications and rework attributable to ambiguous PRDs or acceptance criteria, measured via engineering feedback each quarter. Enablement coverage: 100% of shipped capabilities in the owned area have current capability documentation and a delivered briefing to support and solutions engineering at or before release. Adoption of shipped capability: Customer adoption or usage of newly released capabilities against a target set at launch, tracked for 90 days post-release. Competitive influence: At least one documented roadmap or positioning decision per quarter, traceable to a published competitive finding. What You'll Do Own inbound product direction for your area. Research emerging agentic AI capabilities, attacker techniques, and adjacent standards (MCP, A2A, OWASP agentic-security guidance, agent identity frameworks) to determine what MARS for Agents should build next across the agent registry, Claude integration, Microsoft Copilot integration, MCP Server, MCP Proxy, and LLM proxy. Turn signal into engineering-ready requirements. Translate market, customer, and competitive input into clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria — using LLM-based tools to synthesize call notes, support tickets, standards documents, and usage data into prioritization insight, while retaining full accountability for the judgment calls and the accuracy of what you write. Own and groom the backlog. Make day-to-day prioritization calls across your surfaces within the strategic guardrails set by the Head of Product, and partner directly with engineering through the full build cycle: refinement, in-sprint questions, review, and release. Validate before you specify. Use AI coding assistants, MCP clients, and agent runtimes hands-on to prototype and stress-test proposed behavior — so requirements are grounded in how agents actually behave, not just how they are documented to behave. Define success metrics for what you ship and track them post-release. Enable the field. Brief technical support and solutions engineering on new and existing capabilities, and maintain current capability documentation for your area that clearly separates documented and shipping facts from planned work and open questions, so the field never over-promises. Be the trusted authority on what your part of MARS does today, what is coming, and what it deliberately does not do yet. Engage customers, sales, and marketing. Join customer and prospect conversations periodically to gather requirements, pressure-test positioning, and support technical evaluations; support the sales team with technical Q&A, competitive objection-handling, and input on proposals and decks; and work with product marketing on messaging, positioning, and launch content. Run competitive analysis that changes decisions. Continuously track competitors relevant to MARS for Agents — network/SSE-SASE incumbents (Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Cloudflare, Netskope), agent-identity and IAM players (Okta, CyberArk), MCP gateway vendors, and emerging agent-security pure-plays — and maintain a clear point of view on where MARS leads, where it currently trails, and what capabilities are commoditizing. Feed those findings directly into requirements, positioning, and roadmap prioritization. Functional Competencies Required: 6–10+ years of product management or product owner experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, enterprise infrastructure, or security software, including a track record of owning a complex, technical product area end to end. Demonstrated ability to write clear, engineering-ready requirements (PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria) and to own a backlog end to end for a technically complex product surface. Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy. This role receives strategic direction rather than daily instruction, and the person in it should be able to take a goal and drive it through research, requirements, engineering partnership, and launch across multiple related surfaces at once — with the support of a collaborative product and engineering team. Comfort operating at high velocity. Our engineering organization runs agile at a fast cadence, and this role also helps bring the process and rigor needed to make the product scalable, so both muscles matter. Solid working knowledge of AI agent technology: how LLMs and AI agents operate, the difference between autonomous and human-in-the-loop (hybrid) agents, tool and function calling, and — specifically — the MCP (Model Context Protocol) ecosystem (servers, clients, tool calls) at a depth sufficient to write requirements for an MCP Server and an MCP Proxy, not just discuss them conceptually. Real cybersecurity background, with working familiarity in areas such as identity and access management, proxy and gateway architectures (forward proxy, reverse proxy, secure web gateway / SSE / SASE), and content or traffic inspection. Deep specialization in every area is not required, but enough fluency to engage credibly with engineering and with technical customers is. Hands-on, regular personal use of AI tools — for example Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code / Cowork, GitHub Copilot, or similar — including some exposure to how they use MCP or other tool-calling integrations. Strong written communication, since the role produces a steady stream of specs, FAQs, and internal enablement material. Preferred / Nice to Have: Working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 Copilot ecosystem: M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio agents, and Microsoft's Entra/Azure agent identity plane — enough to scope and write requirements for a two-way integration in which MARS augments Microsoft's own agent governance rather than competing with it. Prior product ownership of an identity or registry system, a proxy or gateway product, or an API/integration platform. Direct experience with MCP, LLM/agent tool-calling architectures, or building integrations with Claude or other frontier model providers. Familiarity with OWASP frameworks, including emerging OWASP guidance for agentic AI security. Experience directly supporting a technical sales motion — SE enablement, competitive battlecards, customer discovery calls. Experience at a company scaling a new product line or product category from early traction. Experience using AI-assisted research or analysis tooling as part of a regular product workflow — for example synthesizing customer feedback at volume, or building lightweight prototypes to validate requirements. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Menlo Mindsets The Menlo Mindsets serve as our strategic operating system, directly linking our daily behaviors to the business results we need to achieve by defining exactly "how" we do our work. By establishing this clear, shared standard, they empower our most successful employees to consistently drive the innovation and accountability required for our long-term success. Proactive Leadership — I do not settle for the status quo. I take ownership, make informed decisions, and proactively communicate to drive results while empowering others to do the same. What it looks like in this role: You receive strategic direction, not a task list — and you are expected to decide what your surfaces should build next, act on it, and keep the Head of Product and your partners informed as you go. Straight Talk — I share honestly and transparently, actively seeking diverse perspectives while encouraging the same. What it looks like in this role: You publish an honest competitive point of view, including where MARS currently trails, and you keep documentation that clearly separates what ships today from what is planned so the field never over-promises. United Impact — I break down barriers to champion cross-functional collaboration, uniting diverse strengths with clear ownership to drive exceptional, aligned outcomes. Elevated Talent — I believe talent is our differentiator, upholding a high bar for performance and leadership and continuous development. Customer-Compelled — Customer focus is my mission. I own their experience, prevent their challenges, and act with urgency to deliver value. What it looks like in this role: You sit in customer and prospect conversations regularly, support live technical evaluations, and carry what you hear straight back into requirements rather than filing it away as research. About Menlo Security Menlo Security's mission: Enabling humans and agents to connect, communicate, and collaborate securely without compromise. Menlo Security's patented Isolation platform protects organizations from cyberattacks by eliminating the threat of malware from the web, documents, and email. raw.title: Claims Validation Handler
raw.description:
We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

The Claims Validation Team
The Claims Validation Team exists to help to defend Marshmallow against fraudulent activity, and to protect the company loss ratio. Fraudulent claims can result in us losing money, which can then result in driving up the premium prices for our honest customers. We’re here to stop that, by making sure that the right claims are reviewed for any policyholder or indemnity related concerns.


What you’ll be doing

  • Reviewing indemnity referrals flagged by our wider claims team, where it has been identified at the point of claim that customers have misrepresented their policy details, and deciding upon the appropriate course of action for the policy and claim

  • Investigating first party claims by communicating with our policyholders by phone and email and conducting follow up investigations

  • Working proactively and efficiently to minimise leakage

  • Contacting customers regarding document requests or any necessary changes to their policy, and providing excellent customer service

  • Collaborating and building strong relationships with both the wider claims and fraud teams

  • Proactively identifying opportunities to improve our processes to help us to protect both the company loss ratio, and our honest customers

Who you are

  • You have an investigative mindset with strong attention to detail and accuracy

  • You are confident in good decision making, and can work efficiently under pressure

  • You have strong communication skills and are comfortable in liaising with other teams from across the business

  • You enjoy working in a high growth environment and are adaptable to change and balancing conflicting priorities

  • You are a self-starter who likes to take ownership

  • You take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience and enjoy interacting with our customers

  • You are tenacious and persistent; knowing when further investigation can lead to positive commercial outcomes for the business

What we're looking for from you

  • A background in fraud or claims/policy validation

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to be able to effectively communicate with our customers

  • You are really passionate about the customer, and will go the extra mile to offer them the best service

  • Working in a fast-paced scale up means that you have to be adaptable and excited by the prospect of moving fast

  • You enjoy finding solutions to problems you come across rather than waiting on others to do this for you

  • You enjoy taking ownership of your own workload, and proactively highlight any blockers that you or your team may be facing

Perks of the job

  • Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance

  • Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva

  • Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year

  • Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

Our process

We break it up into a few stages:

  • Initial call with someone in our Talent Team (30 mins)

  • A skill-based interview where you will discuss your previous experience also with a focus on our values, our culture and your motivations with our Claims Validation Team Lead plus one other team member (1 hour)

We’ll let you know if you’re invited to an interview or not. But, as a small team with a lot of applications to consider, we can’t give personal feedback on each application.

#LI-PT1

Diversity of thought

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. Client Education exists to make that happen. We sit at the intersection of Product, Partnerships, and Customer teams, turning new features and platform capability into training, certification, and documentation that our clients and delivery partners can actually learn from. The team owns the full learning journey: onboarding new clients, building certification pathways, producing courses and video content, and supporting partners who deliver training on our behalf. As hx's product surface has grown - Decision Engine, Pricing & Rating, Portfolio Intelligence, Submission Triage, and our AI agents - so has the volume and complexity of what we need to teach, and we're growing the team to keep pace. We're looking for a Client Education Associate to join as a core part of this effort. Your focus will be delivering technical training directly to clients and partners, and supporting the team in building and maintaining the courses and certifications that make that training possible. You'll need enough technical grounding to be credible in front of a room of actuaries and developers, and enough teaching instinct to make complex material land. Support the design and delivery of certification assessments, including practical exercises where candidates build real pricing tools in the hx platform. Partner with Product, Customer, and Partnerships teams to translate new features into training material clients can actually use from day one. Contribute to our partner enablement programme, helping external delivery partners onboard and deliver hx training to a consistent standard. Help maintain and improve our course health and documentation processes, flagging content that's fallen out of date or out of line with current product naming and messaging. What you'll need to have done Delivered training, workshops, or technical explanations to a non-technical or semi-technical audience, and can point to material you've built or taught from. Taken the initiative to build or improve a course, process, or piece of learning content, rather than just following someone else's structure. Worked well in an environment where scope shifts and you're expected to figure things out rather than wait for a fully defined brief. You'll enable trusted self-service at scale, prove the value of our new product offerings faster, and ship data products directly into the user experience.
